theorem regular (C : Family g.core) (hg : g.IsSimple) (h : C.Makes) : WilsonRegularity (wilsonFamily C) := by
  refine ⟨?_,fun N p v x => C.continuousO N p v.1 v.2 x, fun N p v x => C.invariant h N p v.1 v.2 x, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨2*Pert.Asymptotics.b0 g.core, ?_, fun ε hε => ?_⟩
    · have hc := YM.Gauge.casimir_pos (GaugeGroup.coreSimple hg)
      unfold Pert.Asymptotics.b0
      positivity
    · filter_upwards [Pert.Asymptotics.zeroUp_bound C h hε] with N hN
      exact fun p => hN N p le_rfl
  intro v
  exact ⟨(C.localSection v.1).stencil,fun N p x => C.localO N p v.1 v.2 x⟩

def PositionsUV (C : Family G) (e : Extraction.Sequence) :=
  ∀ (p n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → C.book.Token),
   ∃ f : Points n → ℂ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (NoHit C.S p n) ∧
     (∀ t : Test n, suitable C.S p t → Tendsto (fun j => Order.smears C (e j) p v t) atTop (𝓝 (t.applyTo f))) ∧
     ∀ l : List (Reach n),
       let F N := squall (C.S.a N) l (lifted C N p v)
       let g := derive f (l.map Reach.where_)
       Cluster C e p n F g ∧
       Meets (NoHit C.S p n) (fun j => interpolated C.S (e j) (F (e j))) g ∧
       ∀ t : Test n, suitable C.S p t →
         Integrable (fun x : Points n => t x * g x) ∧
         Tendsto (fun j => sumOn F C.S p (e j) t) atTop (𝓝 (t.applyTo g))
ends.conclusion: `PositionsUV` gives, for every volume `p`, token list `v` and difference list `l`, a limiting kernel `f` (and its derivative `g`) such that the smeared lattice correlations converge along the full sequence for every `suitable` separated test.

theorem wilsonLimit {s : Extraction.Sequence} (h : (Extraction.Order.mk .full s).Ordered C S) :
    (wilsonFamily C).Converges s (fun v => (hierarchy F Q).correlation none ((hierarchy F Q).project ∘ v)) := by
  intro n v t
  obtain ⟨hv,row,hr,hl⟩ := fromWilson C h n v t
  refine ⟨hv,row,hr,?_⟩
  convert hl using 2
  congr 1
  funext x
  change t x * S.useAt S x (S.classTokens ∘ v) = t x * S.read x v
  by_cases hx : x ∈ conf n
  · rw [S.at_project S F.room.kernel.laws.toSymmetric (fun _ => le_rfl) hx]
  · have hz : t x = 0 := notMem_support.mp (fun h => hx (t.tsupport_subset (subset_closure h)))
    simp [hz]
ends.conclusion: `wilsonLimit` identifies the lattice limit with `correlation none (project ∘ v)` using `S.at_project` on `conf n`, and separated tests vanish off `conf n`.

  have ha : AnalyticAt ℝ (bring H d B) 0 := AnalyticAt.pi fun i => hp.shot (B i)

  let L : GaugePanel G m ≃ₗ[ℝ] PanelL2 G m := transport
  let T := L.toLinearMap.comp D.toLinearMap
  have commute (u : G.El) (y : GaugePanel G m) : L (rotates u y) = rotateIso u (L y) := rfl
  have ht (u : G.El) (x : Snap G d) : T (Cast u x) = rotateIso u (T x) := by

  refine ⟨C.comp L.toLinearMap, fun x => hc x, ?_⟩
  intro u y

  rw [commute, he]

private lemma deriv_comm (H : Hol G) (B : Fin m → Slot) (hp : Peg H d)
    (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (bring H d B) 0) (u : G.El) (x : Snap G d) :
    fderiv ℝ (bring H d B) 0 (Cast u x) = rotates u (fderiv ℝ (bring H d B) 0 x) := by
  let F := bring H d B
  let D := fderiv ℝ F 0
  let P : Snap G d →L[ℝ] Snap G d := castL u
  let Q : GaugePanel G m →L[ℝ] GaugePanel G m := rotatesL u
  have ha : HasFDerivAt F D (P 0) := by rw [map_zero]; exact hd.hasFDerivAt
  have ha' : HasFDerivAt (F ∘ P) (D.comp P) 0 := ha.comp 0 P.hasFDerivAt
  have hb : HasFDerivAt (Q ∘ F) (Q.comp D) 0 := Q.hasFDerivAt.comp 0 hd.hasFDerivAt
  have eqn : F ∘ P = Q ∘ F := funext fun a => funext fun i => hp.observes (B i) u a
  rw [eqn] at ha'
  change D.comp P x = Q.comp D x
  rw [ha'.unique hb]

private lemma hammered {X Y ι : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] [CompleteSpace X] [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace ℝ Y] [CompleteSpace Y]
    (f : X → Y) (C : Y →L[ℝ] X) (h : AnalyticAt ℝ f 0) (hh : C.comp (fderiv ℝ f 0)=ContinuousLinearMap.id _ _) (hz : f 0=0) (p : ι → X → X) (q : ι → Y → Y)
    (hx : ∀ i,Tendsto (p i) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)) (hy : ∀ i,Tendsto (q i) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)) (HP : ∀ i x,f (p i x)=q i (f x)) (HQ : ∀ i x,C (q i x)=p i (C x)) : ∃ F : Y → X,
      AnalyticAt ℝ F 0 ∧ F 0=0 ∧ (∀ᶠ i in 𝓝 0,F (f i)=i) ∧ ∀ u,∀ᶠ i in 𝓝 0,F (q u i)=p u (F i) := by
  let g := C ∘ f
  have hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ω g 0 := ((C.analyticAt _).comp h).contDiffAt
  have ha : HasFDerivAt g (ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ X).toContinuousLinearMap 0 := by
    rw [show (ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ X).toContinuousLinearMap= C.comp (fderiv ℝ f 0) from hh.symm]
    exact C.hasFDerivAt.comp 0 h.differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
  let t := hg.toOpenPartialHomeomorph _ ha (by simp)
  have hw : ContDiffAt ℝ ω t.symm (g 0) := hg.to_localInverse ha (show ω≠(0:WithTop ℕ∞) by simp)
  have hT : g 0=0:=by simp [g,hz]
  have hs : (0:X)∈t.source:=ContDiffAt.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source ..
  have ht : t.symm (0:X)=0 := by nth_rw 1 [← hT]; exact t.left_inv hs
  rw [hT] at hw
  let F := t.symm ∘ C
  have hi : F 0=0 := by simp [F,ht]
  have hq := (show AnalyticAt ℝ (t.symm) (C 0) from by rw [map_zero]; exact hw.analyticAt) |>.comp (C.analyticAt _)
  refine ⟨F,hq,hi,?_,fun i => ?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [t.open_source.mem_nhds hs] with i hh; exact t.left_inv hh
  have he : 0∈t.target:= hT ▸ t.map_source hs
  have hl : Tendsto F (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by simpa only [hi] using (show ContinuousAt F 0 from hq.continuousAt).tendsto
  have hu := t.open_source.mem_nhds hs
  have hH := t.open_target.mem_nhds he
  have hw : Tendsto C (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by simpa only [map_zero] using C.continuous.tendsto 0
  filter_upwards [(hl.comp (hy i)).eventually hu,((hx i).comp hl).eventually hu,hw.eventually hH,(hw.comp (hy i)).eventually hH] with x ht hs he hb
  apply t.injOn ht hs
  change t (t.symm (C (q i x))) = g (p i (F x))
  rw [t.right_inv (show C (q i x) ∈ t.target from hb), show g (p i (F x))=p i (t (t.symm (C x))) from by
    change C (f _)=p i (C (f (F x)))
    rw [HP,HQ], t.right_inv he]
  exact HQ _ _

private lemma columns (B : Frame G d) (Y : Label G d →ₗ[ℂ] Pre G) (h : ∀ i:B.Index,
    Y (B.basis i) ∈ powered G (B.grades i).2) :
    ∃ T : SectionData B, pop T ∧ 0∈T.stencil ∧ (∀ s:Signed,T.stencil.image s.act=T.stencil) ∧
      ∀ p, T.evaluate (B.coords p)=Y p := by
  classical
  choose m V Q hq he using fun i : B.Index => powered_pose (h i)
  choose r hr using fun i => Work.G06.enclose (V i)
  let c := Finset.univ.sup r
  have ht i b : (V i b).stencil ⊆ box c := le_trans (hr i b) (by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨h0,h1⟩ := box_test.mp ha
    have hh : r i ≤ c := Finset.le_sup (f:=r) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    exact box_test.mpr ⟨fun j=>by specialize h0 j; omega,fun j=>by specialize h1 j; omega⟩)
  choose E hE using fun i=> Work.G06.realize G (V i) (box c) (ht i)
  let x := B.basis.constr ℂ (fun i=>E i (Q i))
  let T : SectionData B := ⟨box c,x ∘ₗ B.coords.symm.toLinearMap⟩
  let L : Label G d →ₗ[ℂ] Pre G := ((T.eval_linear).mk' _).comp B.coords.toLinearMap
  have hl i : T.evaluate (B.coords (B.basis i)) = Y (B.basis i) := by
    rw [he i]; funext U
    change MvPolynomial.aeval (Source.entry U) (x (B.coords.symm (B.coords _))) = _
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply B.coords (B.basis i), show x (B.basis i)=_ from Module.Basis.constr_basis ..]
    exact hE i U (Q i)
  refine ⟨T,fun i => ?_,center_box _, fun s => box_covariant c s,fun p=> LinearMap.congr_fun (show L=Y from B.basis.ext hl) p⟩
  exact ⟨m i,V i,ht i,Q i,by rw [← B.coords_basis,hl,he i]; rfl,hq i⟩
ends.conclusion: `columns` builds, for a frame `B` and powered label functions `Y`, a `SectionData` on one stencil (`pop`, `0 ∈ T.stencil`, stable under signed permutations) evaluating to `Y` on label coordinates, the construction of the sections of Lemma A1.

lemma min_cov {h : n → G.El} (hs : A.Solves h) (x : n) (k : G.El) :
    ∑ y, ∑ l, A.term h x y l ≤ ∑ y, ∑ l, G.price (k * A.W x y l * (h y)⁻¹) := by
  classical
  let g := update h x k
  let t (p : n → G.El) i j := ∑ l, A.term p i j l
  let M := Finset.univ.erase x
  have hn : 0 < (Fintype.card n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hm : 0 < (Fintype.card L : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have eq (p : n → G.El) : A.cost p = (Fintype.card n:ℝ)⁻¹ * (Fintype.card n:ℝ)⁻¹ * (Fintype.card L:ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ∑ j, t p i j := by
    simp only [cost,avg, smul_eq_mul,← Finset.mul_sum,t,mul_assoc]
  have eq' (p : n → G.El) : (∑ i, ∑ j, t p i j) = (∑ i ∈ M, ∑ j ∈ M, t p i j) + 2*(∑ i, t p x i) := by
    calc
      _ = (∑ i ∈ M, ∑ j, t p i j) + ∑ j, t p x j := by rw [Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ x)]
      _ = (∑ i ∈ M, ((∑ j ∈ M, t p i j)+t p i x)) + ∑ j, t p x j := by
        unfold M; simp
      _ = _ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        have he : (∑ i ∈ M, t p i x) = ∑ i, t p x i := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ x), show t p x x = 0 by simp [t, term,A.same], add_zero]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ A.opposite p _ _
        rw [he]; ring
  have he := hs g
  rw [eq,eq, mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (by positivity), eq', eq'] at he
  have hh (i) (hi : i ∈ M) : g i = h i := update_of_ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hi) ..
  have hd (i) (hi : i ∈ M) (j) (hj : j ∈ M) : t h i j = t g i j := by simp only [t, term, hh i hi, hh j hj]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj ↦ hd i hi j hj,
    add_le_add_iff_left,mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (by positivity)] at he
  apply he.trans
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_
  unfold term g
  by_cases h' : i = x
  · subst i
    simp only [update_self, A.same,mul_one,mul_inv_cancel, G.price_one]
    exact (G.price_range _).1
  simp [h']

skeptics.why: With coefficient 1, the induction bound E(X0)<=4(r-1)(2R+1)F(X0)<=4(r-1)F(X) gives E(X)<=(2R+1)(4r-3)F(X,U)<=4r(2R+1)F(X,U), so the printed constant follows with slack. The coefficient-1 first inequality is also valid, since each plaquette in the (i,j)-plane at x bounds only the link (x,i) (Slide.lean `variation`); Lean's factor 4 in slide_le/window_le comes from bounding each of the 4 link directions at x by the full face sum `field X U x`, a loss [M] does not take.

Coefficient 1 is valid (each link difference between adjacent layers is bounded by the single plaquette spanning it, so the telescoped layer differences sum to at most F(X,U); Lean's 4 comes from the cruder slide_le bound by the whole vertex field summed over 4 axes), and the second inequality is only an upper bound: (2R+1)(4(r-1)F+F)=(2R+1)(4r-3)F <= 4r(2R+1)F, so the display holds as printed.

lemma eligible (P : RG.Patch) (U : CoverConfig G) (C : RG.KernelChoices) (hc : 16 ≤ C.axial_factor) (o : Lattice.Order) :
    ∃ x : P.Points, (x,o)∈ P.eligible C U := by
  let l := allAxes o
  let R := P.radius
  have he := existence l R 0 U ((List.nodup_finRange _).map o.injective) (center_box _)
  have ha (i : Axis) : i ∈ l := List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_,List.mem_finRange _,o.apply_symm_apply i⟩
  rw [show slab R 0 l = box R by ext i; simp only [slab_iff,ha,not_true,false_imp_iff,forall_const,and_true]] at he
  obtain ⟨x,hx,H⟩ := he
  refine ⟨⟨x,hx⟩,?_⟩
  unfold RG.Patch.eligible
  simp only [mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and, edge_cost,face_cost]
  apply H.trans
  rw [card_layers,show l.length=4 by simp [l,allAxes]]
  push_cast
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) ?_) (faces_nonneg ..)
  positivity
ends.conclusion: For `16 ≤ axial_factor` and each order `o`, `existence` with `l.length = 4` gives an eligible tag `(x,o)`.

theorem chosen (h : S.patch.Branches S.kernel G) (U : Config G f) : ∑ t, S.likelihood U t = 1 := by
  let a (r : S.SitesChoice) := ∏ x, S.patch.frameMass S.kernel (expandAt (S.ratio.embed x) U) (r x)
  let b (r : S.SitesChoice) (t : S.BondChoice) :=
    ∏ e, S.patch.predictorMass S.kernel (S.connector U r e) (t e)
  have ha : ∑ i, a i = 1 := by
    unfold a
    rw [← Fintype.prod_sum]
    simp_rw [S.patch.frameMass_sum h]; simp
  have hb (r) : ∑ i, b r i = 1 := by
    unfold b
    rw [← Fintype.prod_sum]; simp_rw [S.patch.predictorMass_sum]; simp
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  change ∑ i, ∑ t, a i * b i t = _
  simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hb, mul_one]; exact ha
ends.conclusion: `∑ t, S.likelihood U t = 1`, by multiplying the frame masses and predictor masses, each summing to one.

theorem frameMass_sum (h : P.Branches C G) (U : CoverConfig G) :
    ∑ i, P.frameMass C U i = 1 := by
  classical
  by_cases ht : P.usesMin C U
  · have hh : 0 < (Fintype.card P.FrameTag : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
    simp only [frameMass, if_pos ht, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul,

  simp_rw [frameMass, if_neg ht]
  have hc : (P.eligible C U).card ≠ 0 := (Finset.card_pos.mpr (h.axial_exists U)).ne'
  simp [hc]

  · have hh : braceAll r (rotor 1 k P.wing)*solo c A'=solo c Q * solo c (rotor 1 k P.land) := by

      congr! 2 with p

    have he := hK.product hX; rw [hh] at he; exact he.lands (hq.product hK') (rotations_crew c _)
  · have he := hQ.product hX
    have hu := (Runs.nil (rotations c (TypeFace 1))).minus (hK'.smult k⁻¹)
    have hh : solo c (going P)*solo c A'=1-(↑(k⁻¹):ℂ) • solo c (rotor 1 k P.land) := by

    have h2 := hq.product (hd'.back (rotations_crew _ _) (rotations_crew _ _))
    rw [div_self (stage_ne f),one_smul] at h1; rw [div_self (stage_ne c),one_smul] at h2
    have hh : (braceAll r (signal 1 1))ᴴ * solo c T'= solo c Q * (solo c (signal 1 1))ᴴ := by

      congr! 2 with p

      rw [← mirage_herm _ _ (alias_real (hm p).1 _),← mirage_herm _ _ (hm p).1]; exact (scaled_tri P k hk (hm p) l).2.1
    rw [hh] at h1; have he := h1.lands h2 (rotations_crew c _)
    apply transpose_injective; simp only [transpose_mul, transpose_transpose]; exact he
  have hW := (heart_true _ hk hj P.wing).1.fine r P.odd
  have hW' := (heart_true _ hk ht P.land).1.coarse c
  have h1 := (hY.product hW').product hd'; have h2 := (hW.product hd).product hX

lemma scheme (i : S.patch.Points) : ContDiffAt ℝ ω (fun v : In G f => hats S y t v i) 0 := by
  let a := hats S y t (G:=G)
  let F := uncurry (fun x u => plant S y (x,u)) (α:=In G f)
  have hk : ContDiffAt ℝ ω F (0,a 0) := by
    refine contDiffAt_pi.mpr fun v => ?_
    unfold F uncurry plant
    dsimp only
    split
    · exact ((contDiffAt_apply ℝ G.Mat v _).comp ((0:In G f),a 0) contDiffAt_snd).sub contDiffAt_const
    apply ((contDiffAt_apply ℝ G.Mat v _).comp ((0:In G f),a 0) contDiffAt_snd).sub
    have hh : ContDiffAt ℝ ω (fun x => G.mat (G.focus x)) (cloud S y (0,a 0) v)  :=
      by rw [show cloud _ _ _ _=1 from cloud_zero S y t (h:=h) _]; exact G.focus_diff
    exact hh.comp (f:=fun p => cloud S y p v) ((0:In G f),a 0) (cloud_form S y v (a 0))
  have hx : ∀ᶠ x : In G f in 𝓝 0,F (x,a x)=0 := by
    filter_upwards [roots S y t (G:=G), eventually_all.mpr (stars S y t (h:=h))] with x hx hh
    funext i; change plant _ _ _ _=_; unfold plant; split
    next hi => rw [hi]; simp [a,hx]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (hh i)
  refine (contDiffAt_apply ℝ G.Mat i _).comp 0 (authored a F 0 hx (continuousAt_pi.mpr fun i => hat_cont S y t (h:=h) i) hk fun u H => ?_)
ends.conclusion: The frame choice `hats` is real analytic near 0: the self-consistency equation `plant` (a nearest-point fixed point of the averaged `cloud`) is analytic and the real-analytic implicit function lemma `authored` applies with a trivial-kernel derivative.

lemma link_bound (S : StepData c f) (h : S.patch.Branches S.kernel G)
    (H : Forest S.ratio) (k : S.Choices) (x : Dir G f)
    (hx : ∀ e ∈ H.trunks, collect G x e = 0)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (e : Bond f)
    (hcops : ∀ U : Config G f, Stores.SliceSet S H U → usable S U (S.ratio.parent e.1) k →
      Cops (S := S) U 1 (S.prediction U k) e C) :
    ‖collect G x e‖ ≤ C * (∑ z ∈ box (macroR S.patch), ∑ p : PlaqAxes,
      ‖dColor G f 1 x (wrap f z + S.ratio.embed (S.ratio.parent e.1), plaquette p)‖) +
      ‖bills S x (S.ratio.parent e.1, coord e.2)‖ := by
  let U := fun t : ℝ => represent (t • x)
  have hu : U 0 = 1 := by simp [U]
  let i := S.ratio.parent e.1
  let edge : Bond c := (i, e.2)
  let loc := fun z : Cover => wrap f z + S.ratio.embed i
  let X := box (macroR S.patch)
  have he := chord_limit (U := fun t => U t e) (by rw [hu]; rfl) (represent_deriv x e)
  have hp := chord_limit (U := fun t => S.prediction (U t) k edge)
    (by rw [hu]; exact Push.settled S h edge k) (Push.prices S h edge k x)
  have hs (z : Cover) (p : PlaqAxes) :
      Tendsto (fun t => ‖t‖⁻¹ * G.chord (faceValue (U t) (loc z,p)))
        (𝓝[≠] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 ‖dColor G f 1 x (loc z, plaquette p)‖) := by
    apply chord_limit
    · unfold U faceValue; rw [zero_smul]; exact Push.stroll_zero _ _
    · rw [← fundamental]; exact Push.travell _ _ _
  have ht : Tendsto (fun t => ∑ z ∈ X, ∑ p : PlaqAxes,
      ‖t‖⁻¹ * G.chord (faceValue (U t) (loc z,p))) (𝓝[≠] (0 : ℝ))
        (𝓝 (∑ z ∈ X, ∑ p : PlaqAxes, ‖dColor G f 1 x (loc z,plaquette p)‖)) := by
    apply tendsto_finsetSum; intro z _; exact tendsto_finsetSum _ fun p _ => hs z p
  apply le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto he ((ht.const_mul C).add hp)
  filter_upwards [(usable_near S x k i).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds] with t ht'
  have htree : Stores.SliceSet S H (U t) := by
    intro u hub
    change G.lieExp (t • (collect G x u)) * (1:G.El) = _
    rw [hx u hub, smul_zero, G.mat_lieExp_zero, mul_one]
  have ha := hcops (U t) htree ht'
  have ha' : G.chord ((U t) e) ≤ C * port S i (U t) + G.chord (S.prediction (U t) k edge) := by
    unfold Cops at ha
    simp only [replica_one, wire, Pi.one_apply, inv_one, mul_one, one_mul, G.chord_inv] at ha
    split at ha
    · exact ha.trans (add_le_add_right (G.chord_nonneg _) _)
    · exact ha
  change ‖t‖⁻¹ * G.chord ((U t) e) ≤ C * (∑ z ∈ X, ∑ p : PlaqAxes,
    ‖t‖⁻¹ * G.chord (faceValue (U t) (loc z,p))) + ‖t‖⁻¹ * G.chord (S.prediction (U t) k edge)
  have hh := ha'.trans (add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (port_le S (U t) i) hC) _)
  apply (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (show 0 ≤ ‖t‖⁻¹ by positivity)).trans_eq
  simp only [mul_add, mul_left_comm ‖t‖⁻¹ C, Finset.mul_sum, X, loc]

    _ ≤ _ := by linarith only [hi]

have hsmall (i : Cell f) (hi : i ∈ A.costs \ K) : a / 128 * t ^ 2 ≤ F i := by
    let v := T.Mv (till x) (temp x) V (i,false)
    obtain ⟨hi, hk⟩ := mem_sdiff.mp hi
    have hu : toll U i ≤ t := le_of_not_gt fun h =>
      hk (mem_filter.mpr ⟨hi, h⟩)
    have hm : t/4 ≤ toll U i := (p.consumes i (fun h =>
      disjoint_left.mp h (cost_at_home hi _) (base_mem_start ..))).1 hi
    have hd : Real.sqrt a * t / 8 ≤ Real.sqrt a * toll U i - ‖v‖ := by
      have he : ‖v‖ ≤ Real.sqrt a / 8 * t :=
        (M (i,false)).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hquad ht)
      have hx : Real.sqrt a * (t/4) ≤ Real.sqrt a * toll U i :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm (Real.sqrt_nonneg a)
      linarith only [he, hx]
    refine le_trans ?_ (square_direct T U V x t i hu)
    change _ ≤ (Real.sqrt a * toll U i - ‖v‖)^2 / 2
    have eq : (Real.sqrt a * t / 8)^2 / 2 = a / 128 * t^2 := by
      rw [div_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt ac]; ring
    rw [← eq]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hd 2) (by norm_num)
  have hlarge (i : Cell f) (hi : i ∈ K) : 3/4*b*t*toll U i ≤ F i := by
    let y := Pressure.shoot T.high U i
    let v := T.Mv (till x) (temp x) V (i,false)
    let r := toll U i
    have he : t < r := (mem_filter.mp hi).2
    have hr : ‖v‖ * ‖y‖ ≤ ε * t * (Real.sqrt a * r) :=
      mul_le_mul (M (i,false)) (shoot_norm T U i) (norm_nonneg _) ((norm_nonneg _).trans (M (i,false)))
    have hx : inner ℝ v y ≤ b / 4 * t * r := calc
      _ ≤ ‖v‖ * ‖y‖ := real_inner_le_norm ..
      _ ≤ ε * t * (Real.sqrt a * r) := hr
      _ = (ε * Real.sqrt a) * (t*r) := by ring
      _ ≤ b / 4 * (t*r) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlin (mul_nonneg ht' (toll_nonneg ..))
      _ = b / 4 * t * r := by ring
    change 3/4*b*t*r ≤ PathData.clipped T.high t r + ‖v‖^2 / 2 - inner ℝ v y
    rw [PathData.clipped, if_neg (not_le.mpr he)]
    change 3/4*b*t*r ≤ b*t*r + ‖v‖^2 / 2 - inner ℝ v y
    linarith only [hx, sq_nonneg ‖v‖]

private lemma dropped_cost (T : Tube G S) (A : Stores S) {x C w : ℝ}
    {U : Config G f} {k : S.Choices} {V : Config G c} (p : A.Plot U k V x w)
    (ht : 0 < fiery G x S.patch.L)
    (E : LaneCounts T.up x (fiery G x S.patch.L) T.high C 1 S.ratio.parent) :
    let t := fiery G x S.patch.L

      cloudPrice T.high.relaxation * ∑ j ∈ A.swell U t, toll U j := by

  let K := A.swell U t
  let X := droppedRows T A x t U
  let F (j : Cell f) := clouds j.1 T.high.relaxation (toll U j / t)
  have sub : X ⊆ K.biUnion F := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨hi, hd⟩ : i ∈ A.limit x ∧ ¬ PathData.kept T.high t i.1 U := mem_filter.mp hi

    obtain ⟨hh, hs⟩ := cloud_mem (T := T) (U := U) (i := i) (j := j) ht hj
    exact mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨j, in_swell p ht.le (limit_reach hi (E.dropped U i.1 j hj)) hh, hs⟩
  have ha : X.card ≤ ∑ j ∈ K, (F j).card := (card_le_card sub).trans card_biUnion_le
  have hc : (X.card : ℝ) ≤ ∑ j ∈ K, ((F j).card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast ha

  refine le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (show 0 ≤ t from ht.le)) ?_

private lemma cloud_size (a : Site f) {y R : ℝ} (hy : 1 ≤ y) (hr : 0 ≤ R) :
    ((clouds a R y).card : ℝ) ≤ cloudPrice R * y := by
  let r := Nat.floor (Real.log y * R)
  have hf : (r : ℝ) ≤ Real.log y * R := Nat.floor_le (mul_nonneg (Real.log_nonneg hy) hr)
  have he : (r : ℝ) + r + 1 ≤ (8*R+1) * Real.exp (Real.log y / 4) := by
    have h := Real.add_one_le_exp (Real.log y / 4)
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hr
    nlinarith only [h, h1, hf, hr, Real.log_nonneg hy]
  have hp : Real.exp (Real.log y / 4) ^ 4 = y := calc
    _ = Real.exp (((4:ℕ):ℝ) * (Real.log y / 4)) := (Real.exp_nat_mul _ _).symm
    _ = _ := by norm_num; rw [show (4:ℝ) * (Real.log y / 4) = Real.log y by ring,
      Real.exp_log (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hy)]
  have hn : (clouds a R y).card ≤ ((r+r+1)^4) * Fintype.card PlaqAxes := by
    unfold clouds
    rw [card_product, card_univ]
    apply Nat.mul_le_mul_right
    simpa using Corona.halo_size ({a} : Support f) r
  calc
    ((clouds a R y).card : ℝ) ≤ ((r:ℝ) + r + 1)^4 * (Fintype.card PlaqAxes : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hn
    _ ≤ ((8*R+1) * Real.exp (Real.log y / 4))^4 * (Fintype.card PlaqAxes : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) he 4) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = cloudPrice R * y := by rw [mul_pow, hp]; unfold cloudPrice; ring

    fun s u hu => (areaCost s h he hv hp hu).less hh le_rfl hu,fun u hu => ?_,fun u hu => ?_,fun u hu => ?_⟩

lemma editCosts {R : ℕ} (h : RatesPaid p p σ C k A B) (he : Gapped (A B) η) (hv : Price σ C η d 1 V 1 k)

lemma residualInverse (h : RatesPaid p p σ C k (storm W A) B) (hc : 0≤C)

    (he : RatesPaid p p σ r k (action (obscure W A) 0) B) (hp : 0 ≤ d) (hd : d+k*d≤σ) :

  let F y := storm W A y*action (obscure W A) 0 y
  have ht : RatesPaid p p d (tagPrice 1 k C r) k (fun y => (-1:ℝ)• F y) B := by
    have ht := Bundle.scale hz (-1:ℝ); simpa only [abs_neg,abs_one,one_mul] using ht
  refine Bundle.glue ht ?_

  let k := S.lens i; let r := flay k; let x : ℂ := pebb k; let D := laxa k; let C := -(G.casimir:ℂ); let L := (perL k)^2
  let U (t : ℝ) := x⁻¹ * L * C

  have hV : (fun t=> (haloC S herr i t).trace)=ᶠ[𝓝 0] M /D := (waveVec b k hp i h hS hv rfl).trans (Eventually.of_forall fun t=> by unfold M D; rw [Pi.div_apply]; unfold x L C; ring)
  have hz : x≠0 := laxa_nz hp; have ht : D 0=x := by unfold D laxa x; simp
  have hh : D=fun t:ℝ => x+(2*(k 0:ℂ))*(t:ℂ)+ (1:ℂ)*(t:ℂ)^2 := by ext1 a; unfold D; rw [axa]; unfold x; ring
  have hm : M=fun t:ℝ => x⁻¹*(4*L*C)+0*(t:ℂ)+(x⁻¹*(-8)*C)*(t:ℂ)^2 := by ext1 t; unfold M; ring
  have he : AnalyticAt ℝ M 0 := analyticAt_const.mul ((analyticAt_const.sub (AnalyticAt.mul analyticAt_const ((Complex.ofRealCLM.analyticAt 0).pow 2))).mul analyticAt_const)
  have hx : D 0≠0 := by rw [ht]; exact hz
  rw [flare_tape hU, flare_tape hV, divCatch D U (laxa_green k) analyticAt_const hx, divCatch D M (laxa_green k) he hx]; rw [show flareY 1 D= _ from hh ▸ (binomialV ..).2,show flareY 2 D=_ from hh ▸ (binomialV ..).1]
  rw [show flareY 2 M=_ from hm ▸ (binomialV ..).1,show flareY 1 M=_ from hm ▸ (binomialV ..).2,show flareY 2 U=0 from flare_oneZ _ (by decide), show flareY 1 U=0 from flare_oneZ _ (by decide),ht]

theorem wire (p : Permit M I a) {K : KernelChoices} {X : MapPrices} {l γ b}

lemma relative_four {a : G.ColorIndex} (hG : G.Simple) (hw : Signature G true W) (hu : ContDiffAt ℂ ω W 0)

lemma Signature.color_scalar (h : Signature G b V) (hG : G.Simple) {p : Momentum} (hp : star p = p) (i j : Axis) :
    ∃ c : ℂ, ∀ a b, V p (i,a) (j,b) = if a=b then c else 0 := by
  let J (i : Axis) := (paint G Axis).symm.toLinearMap.comp (LinearMap.single ℝ (fun _ => G.Color) i)
  let K (i : Axis) := ((Complex.ofRealAm.toLinearMap.compLeft _).comp (J i))
  let S := Matrix.toLinearMap₂' ℂ (S₁:=ℂ) (S₂:=ℂ) (V p)
  let T := LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ (fun (x y : G.Color) => S (K i x) (K j y))
      (fun _ _ _ => by simp) (fun _ _ _ => by simp) (fun _ _ _ => by simp) (fun _ _ _ => by simp)
  have he v (a : Axis) (x : G.Color) : K a (G.adjoint v x) = fiberColor G v *ᵥ K a x := by
    change cvec (J _ _) = fiberColor G v *ᵥ cvec _
    rw [fiberColor,cmat_mulVec]
    congr 1; apply (paint G Axis).injective; ext1 b
    rw [paint_adjoints]
    change paint G Axis ((paint G Axis).symm _) _ = G.adjoint _ (paint G Axis ((paint G Axis).symm _) _)
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    by_cases hb : b=a <;> simp [*, LinearMap.single_apply]
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := scalar_complex hG T (fun u x y => by
    change S _ _ = S _ _; unfold S; rw [he,he, Matrix.toLinearMap₂'_apply',Matrix.toLinearMap₂'_apply']
    conv_rhs => rw [← h.color p hp u,← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_transpose])
  let e := EuclideanSpace.basisFun G.ColorIndex ℝ
  have hb (i : Axis) a : K i (e a) = Pi.single (i,a) 1 := by
    ext1 ⟨k,l⟩; change Complex.ofReal ((Pi.single i (e a) : Axis → G.Color) k l) = _
    by_cases h : k=i <;> by_cases h' : l=a <;> simp [*, e]
  refine ⟨z,fun a b => ?_⟩
  have he := hz (e a) (e b)
  change S (K i _) (K j _) = _ at he
  unfold S at he
  rw [hb,hb, Matrix.toLinearMap₂'_apply', Matrix.mulVec_single_one,single_dotProduct,one_mul] at he
  split
  next h => simpa only [h,e.inner_eq_one,ofReal_one,mul_one,Matrix.col_apply] using he
  next h => simpa only [e.orthonormal.2 h,ofReal_zero,mul_zero,Matrix.col_apply] using he
ends.conclusion: For a simple gauge group the colour block of `V p` is scalar, `V p (i,a) (j,b) = if a=b then c else 0`.

lemma mark_pair₂ {a : G.ColorIndex} (hG : G.Simple) (hα : probe₂ V a = 0) {l k : Axis} (hlk : l≠k) : mark V 2 (unitAxis l + unitAxis k) = 0 := by
  let p := unitAxis l + unitAxis k
  have hm := h.mark_axis₂ hd hG hα
  have hS := h.short_two hd
  have hdia (i j : Axes G) (he : i.1=j.1) : mark V 2 p i j = 0 := by
    let s := Signed.mirror l
    have hs := h.mark_spin hd hS s (Or.inl rfl) p i j
    simp only [p,Signed.act_add,s,unit_act,Signed.mirror,Equiv.refl_apply,hlk, Prod.mk.eta,decide_eq_true_eq, ite_true, ite_false,neg_smul,one_smul] at hs
    rw [he] at hs
    have ht : mark V 2 (-unitAxis l + unitAxis k) i j = mark V 2 p i j := hs.trans (by split <;> simp [p])
    have hv := mark_cross hd (unitAxis l) (unitAxis k); rw [hm,hm,zero_add,smul_zero] at hv
    have hv' : mark V 2 p i j + mark V 2 (-unitAxis l + unitAxis k) i j = 0 := congr_fun (congr_fun hv i) j
    rw [ht] at hv'; linear_combination hv' / 2
  have hoff (i j : Axes G) (ha : i.1≠l) (hb : i.1≠k) (hc : i.1≠j.1) : mark V 2 p i j = 0 := by
    have hv := h.mark_spin hd hS (Signed.mirror i.1) (Or.inl rfl) p i j
    simp only [p,Signed.act_add,unit_act,Signed.mirror,Equiv.refl_apply,ha,hb,hc,Prod.mk.eta,decide_eq_true_eq, ite_true, ite_false,one_smul,neg_mul,one_mul] at hv
    dsimp [p]; linear_combination hv / 2
  ext ⟨i,b⟩ ⟨j,c⟩; change mark V 2 p (i,b) (j,c) = 0
  by_cases h₁ : i=j
  · exact hdia _ _ h₁
  by_cases hi : i=l ∨ i=k
  swap
  · exact hoff _ _ (fun h => hi (Or.inl h)) (fun h => hi (Or.inr h)) h₁
  by_cases hj : j=l ∨ j=k
  swap
  · have hv := h.mark_symmetry hd p 2
    rw [mark_neg,neg_sq,one_pow,one_smul] at hv
    rw [← hv,transpose_apply]; exact hoff _ _ (fun h => hj (Or.inl h)) (fun h => hj (Or.inr h)) (Ne.symm h₁)
  have ht : mark V 2 p (i,b) (l,c) + mark V 2 p (i,b) (k,c) = 0 := h.atSum hd hS (i,b) (l,c) k
  rcases hi with rfl|rfl <;> rcases hj with rfl|rfl
  · exact (h₁ rfl).elim
  · rwa [hdia (i,b) (i,c) rfl,zero_add] at ht
  · rwa [hdia (i,b) (i,c) rfl,add_zero] at ht
  exact (h₁ rfl).elim
ends.conclusion: Mirror reflections (`mark_spin` with `Signed.mirror`) kill the degree-two coefficient on `unitAxis l + unitAxis k` for `l ≠ k`.

    (h : R.Bounds p a C u) (hp : 0 < b) (hb : b ≤ a) (hC : C ≤ D) (hu : u ≤ v) : R.Bounds p b D v := by

    exact ⟨by positivity,mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hh _) hk⟩

    h.invariant,h.symTerms,h.metric,h.loopTerms,h.loop_normal⟩

lemma reachable_chord (G : Gauge) [Nontrivial G.Color] :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ h ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) ε, ∃ u : G.El, G.chord u = h := by
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := exists_ne (0:G.Color)
  let γ (t : ℝ) := G.lieExp (t • c)
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < G.chord (γ t) := by
    by_contra! ha
    have hz : (fun t => G.curvature (γ t)) = fun _ => 0 := funext fun t => norm_le_zero_iff.mp <|
      (G.curvature_norm _).trans (ha t)
    have hd : HasDerivAt (fun t => G.curvature (γ t)) c 0 := G.leading_curvature c
    rw [hz] at hd
    exact hc (hd.unique (hasDerivAt_const _ _))
  have hg : Continuous (fun t => G.chord (γ t)) := G.continuous_chord.comp (G.lieExp_cont.comp (by fun_prop))
  refine ⟨_,ht,fun h hh => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := intermediate_value_univ 0 t hg (show h ∈ Icc (G.chord (γ 0)) _ by simpa [γ] using hh)
  exact ⟨γ x,hx⟩

  have hq x : Summable (q x) := (hx x).2.1
  have hs := summable_sum (s:=Finset.univ) (fun x _ => hq x)
  have he i : ‖S.regularOccurrence P i V‖ ≤ ∑ x, q x i := by
    have hh : Healthy P.threshold (S.reg i).support V := by simp [Healthy,hV]
    simp only [q, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true, regularOccurrence,masked_eq _ _ _ _ hh]

  have ht := hs.of_nonneg_of_le (fun i => norm_nonneg _) he

lemma marched (h : (S:Set κ).PairwiseDisjoint Z) (f : κ → (ι→Ω) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i∈S, Measurable (f i))

    exact H S (Finset.Subset.refl _)
  intro V; induction V using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => intro; simp

    let Y := v.biUnion Z

lemma multiplication (a b : Poly R) : price w (a*b) ≤ price w a*price w b := by
  unfold price

  change price w (a*b) ≤ _
  conv_lhs => rw [← studs a,← studs b,sum_mul]
  apply le_trans (batch hw ..)
  rw [sum_mul]; refine sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
  rw [mul_sum,mul_sum]; exact (batch hw ..).trans (sum_le_sum fun j _ ↦ binary hw ..)
ends.conclusion: `price w (a*b) ≤ price w a * price w b` for the weighted ℓ¹ price: the product with the overlapping terms deleted does not exceed the product of the majorants.

lemma flat_critical (hG : G.Simple) {f : Pot G n} (h : p.Regular X f) : fderiv ℝ (germ f) 0 = 0 := by
  let F := germ f
  have he (k : G.El) : F ∘ colorMove k = F := funext fun u => by simpa only [comp_apply, exp_move,F,germ] using h.symmetry (fun _ => k) (increment 1 u)
  have hI (k : G.El) (u : Dir G n) : fderiv ℝ F 0 (colorMove k u) = fderiv ℝ F 0 u := by
    let a := colorMove (n:=n) k
    have hh : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (a 0) := (a.map_zero.symm ▸ (germ_diff h).differentiableAt (by decide))
    have hD := ((hh.hasFDerivAt.comp 0 a.hasFDerivAt).fderiv)
    rw [he k, a.map_zero] at hD
    exact (congr($hD u)).symm
  have hz (e : Edge (Site n)) (c : G.Color) : fderiv ℝ F 0 (edgeLane e c) = 0 := by
    let L := (fderiv ℝ F 0).toLinearMap ∘ₗ edgeLane (G:=G) e
    have hl (k : G.El) (w : G.Color) : colorMove k (edgeLane e w) = edgeLane e (G.adjoint k w) := by
      funext i
      change G.adjoint k (Pi.single (M:=fun _ => G.Color) e w i) = Pi.single (M:=fun _ => G.Color) e (G.adjoint k w) i
      by_cases hi : i = e
      · subst i; simp
      simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hi]
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun (StressFlux.linear_invariant hG L fun k w => by
      change fderiv ℝ F 0 (edgeLane e _) = _; rw [← hl k w,hI]; rfl) c
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun u => ?_
  have hl : (∑ i : Edge (Site n), edgeLane i (u i)) = u := by
    funext j; simp [edgeLane, Finset.sum_apply,Pi.single_apply]
  change fderiv ℝ F 0 u = 0
  rw [← hl, map_sum]; simp [hz]
ends.conclusion: For simple `G`, constant colour invariance (`he`, `hI`) forces `fderiv ℝ (germ f) 0` to vanish on each link lane (`hz`, via `StressFlux.linear_invariant`), hence everywhere.

private lemma extinguish (a : Fin m → ℕ) (v : Fin m → Directions G n)
    (he : ∑ i,a i ≤ 4) (hA : ∀ i, 1 ≤ a i) (hv : ∀ i, a i ≤ 2 → screen X (v i) ∈ Mom.Maps o X (a i)) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (f ∘ increment 1) 0 v = 0 := by
  by_cases hx : ∃ i, 2 < a i
  · obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hx
    have hm : (Finset.univ.erase i).card+1=m := (Finset.card_erase_add_one (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans (by simp)
    have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (s:= Finset.univ.erase i) (f:=fun _ => 1) (fun i _ => hA i); rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)] at he
    simp only [Finset.sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,mul_one] at hs
    change (Finset.univ.erase i).card ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, a j at hs
    have hM : 0 < m := i.pos
    rcases show m=1 ∨ m=2 by omega with hj|hj
    · subst m; rw [iteratedFDeriv_one_apply, show fderiv ℝ (f ∘ increment 1) 0=0 from flat_critical g h.good]; rfl
    subst m
    change iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (f ∘ increment 1) 0 _ = _
    rw [show v= ![v 0,v 1] from funext fun i => by fin_cases i <;> rfl]
    change logHessian f (v 0) (v 1)=0
    have hz : a 0 + a 1 ≤ 4 := by rwa [Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i),Fin.sum_univ_two] at he
    fin_cases i
    · have ht : a 1 = 1 := by change 2 < a 0 at hi; have := hA 1; omega
      rw [hessian_symm h.good]; exact h.constant_hessian g hX hn (by simpa only [ht] using hv 1 (show a 1 ≤ 2 by omega))
    · have ht : a 0 = 1 := by change 2 < a 1 at hi; have := hA 0; omega
      exact h.constant_hessian g hX hn (by simpa only [ht] using hv 0 (show a 0 ≤ 2 by omega))
  exact h.ghost g hX hn v hA he (fun i => hv i (le_of_not_gt (fun h => hx ⟨i,h⟩)))

lemma Prereset.value_income (h : Prereset B q s N m p Q u S) (hV : flags (B.a.budget m).threshold V = ∅)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x∈s) :
    (0 < target Q x 1 ∧ 0 < target Q x V) ∧ |scalar (target Q) x - u x| ≤ funds B.a m q / 4 ∧
      |vacuumError B N Q V x| ≤ sites (B.a.S.side m p) * (funds B.a m q / 2) := by
  have h₀ := preBound (h.early x hx) (flags_one _)
  have hh := preBound (h.early x hx) hV
  constructor
  · exact ⟨(Real.exp_pos _).trans_eq (h.emit x hx 1 (flags_one _)).symm,(Real.exp_pos _).trans_eq (h.emit x hx V hV).symm⟩
  constructor
  · let n := B.a.S.side m p
    have hn : sites n ≠ 0 := (sites_pos n).ne'
    rw [scalar,h.flat hx,sub_div,mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hn,sub_sub_cancel_left,abs_neg, abs_div,abs_of_pos (sites_pos n)]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (sites_pos n)).mpr; rw [mul_comm]; exact h₀

  obtain ⟨h1,h2⟩ := abs_le.mp h₀; obtain ⟨h3,h4⟩ := abs_le.mp hh; exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith,by linarith⟩

private lemma mayer_sum (f : Finset ℕ → ℝ) (l : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : Summable (fun i => ‖f i‖)) (hl : Summable l) :
    HasSum (fun c : Finset (ℕ ⊕ ℕ) => f c.toLeft * (∏ i ∈ c.toRight, (Real.exp (l i) - 1)))
      ((∑' b, f b) * Real.exp (∑' i, l i)) := by
  let y := fun i => Real.exp (l i) - 1
  let g := fun b : Finset ℕ => ∏ i ∈ b, y i
  have hy : Summable y := by
    refine (hl.norm.mul_left 2).of_norm_bounded_eventually ?_
    filter_upwards [hl.norm.tendsto_cofinite_zero.eventually_le_const zero_lt_one] with i hi
    change ‖Real.exp (l i) - 1‖ ≤ 2 * ‖l i‖
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hi ⊢
    exact Real.abs_exp_sub_one_le hi
  have hg : Summable g := summable_finsetProd_of_summable_norm hy.norm

lemma forest {f : ι → ℝ} {a γ} (ha : 0≤ a) (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i) (hh : Hit X M f (a+1) γ)
    (hp : (M+M+1:ℕ)^4*(γ:ℝ) ≤ 1) (hG : 0≤γ) (x : Site n) :
    SumBudget (roots X M f a x) (Real.exp γ-1) := by
  have he (i : Finset ι) : 0≤roots X M f a x i := by
    unfold roots; split
    · exact mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (prod_nonneg fun i _ => hf i)
    exact le_rfl
  let Y := ({x} : Support n)
  have hy (s : Finset (Finset ι)) : (∑ i∈s,roots X M f a x i) ≤ Real.exp γ-1 := by
    let A := s.biUnion id
    let F := (pouch X A Y)
    let v := fun i => f i * Real.exp (a*coverNumber M (X i))
    let g := fun p : Finset ι => ∏ i∈p,v i
    let u := s.filter (fun p => Spark X p ∧ x∈p.biUnion X)
    have hU := step X M hf hh A Y fun P _ y => all_pack X M hf hh hp hG P y
    have hC : ∑ p∈F.erase ∅,g p ≤ Real.exp γ-1 := by
      have hs : (∅:Finset ι) ∈ F := (op _ _ _).mpr ⟨empty_subset _,fun _ hi => absurd hi (notMem_empty _)⟩
      rw [le_sub_iff_add_le, show (1:ℝ) = g ∅ by simp [g], sum_erase_add F _ hs]
      simpa only [F, g,v,film,Y, card_singleton, Nat.cast_one, one_mul] using hU
    calc
      _ = ∑ i ∈ u,roots X M f a x i := by
        symm; apply sum_subset (filter_subset ..)
        intro s hs hh'; have hj : ¬ (Spark X s ∧ x∈s.biUnion X) := fun H => hh' (mem_filter.mpr ⟨hs,H⟩)
        exact if_neg hj
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ u, g i := by
        refine sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_
        have h := (mem_filter.mp hi).2
        unfold roots; rw [if_pos h]; simp only [g,v,prod_mul_distrib,← Real.exp_sum,← mul_sum]
        rw [mul_comm]; gcongr
        · exact prod_nonneg fun i _ => hf i
        exact_mod_cast cover X M h.1
      _ ≤ _ := by
        apply le_trans _ hC; apply sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
        · intro j hj; obtain ⟨hj',hr,hp⟩ := mem_filter.mp hj; obtain ⟨b,h1,h2⟩ := mem_biUnion.mp hp
          refine mem_erase.mpr ⟨hr.1.ne_empty,(op _ _ _).mpr ⟨fun k hk => mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨j,hj',hk⟩,?_⟩⟩
          exact fun i hi => ⟨b,h1,⟨x,mem_singleton_self _,h2⟩,hr.2 b h1 i hi⟩
        intro i _ _; exact prod_nonneg fun j _ => (mul_nonneg (hf j) (Real.exp_pos _).le)
  have ht := summable_of_sum_le (f:=roots X M f a x) he hy
  exact ⟨he,ht,ht.tsum_le_of_sum_le hy⟩

theorem left_prod_bound (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Config G n → ℂ) {U : Config G n}
    {D : Directions G n → Prop} {a : ι → ℝ} {k : ℕ} (h : ∀ i∈s, Chart k (f i) U)
    (hc : ∀ i∈s, ∀ l : List (Directions G n), l.length ≤ k → (∀ v∈l, D v) → ‖leftDerivs (f i) l U‖ ≤ a i) :
    ∀ l : List (Directions G n), l.length ≤ k → (∀ v∈l, D v) →
      ‖leftDerivs (∏ i ∈ s, f i) l U‖ ≤ (s.card:ℝ)^l.length * ∏ i∈s, a i := by
  classical
  intro l hl hD
  induction l using List.reverseRecOn generalizing f k with
  | nil => simp only [leftDerivs, List.length_nil, Finset.prod_apply, norm_prod, pow_zero,one_mul]; exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun i hi => hc i hi [] hl hD)
  | append_singleton l A ih =>
    let f' (i j : ι) := if j = i then leftDerivs (f i) [A] else f j
    have he : l.length+1 ≤ k := by simpa using hl
    have hx (i) (hi : i∈s) (j) (hj : j∈s) : Chart l.length (f' i j) U := by
      unfold f'; split
      · exact leftDerivs_chart _ l.length ((h i hi).of_le (Nat.cast_le.mpr (Nat.add_comm .. ▸ he)))
      exact (h j hj).of_le (Nat.cast_le.mpr (Nat.le_of_succ_le he))
    have ht : leftDerivs (∏ i ∈ s, f i) [A] ∘ increment U =ᶠ[𝓝 0] (∑ i∈s, ∏ j∈s, f' i j) ∘ increment U := by
      have h' (i) (hi : i∈s) : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 0, Chart k (f i) (increment U x) :=
        chart_eventually (by rw [Work.G07.at_zero_increment]; exact h i hi) fun j => by simp only [increment,G.mat_mul]; exact ((G.exp_jet.comp (contDiff_apply ..)).mul contDiff_const).contDiffAt
      filter_upwards [(s.eventually_all).2 h'] with x hx
      have hy (i) (hi : i∈s) := left_has A (l:=[]) (by simp; omega) (hx i hi)
      have hh := (HasDerivAt.fun_finsetProd hy).deriv
      simp only [zero_smul,Work.G07.at_zero_increment,leftDerivs] at hh
      simp only [comp_apply,leftDerivs, Finset.prod_apply,Finset.sum_apply,hh]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
      rw [← Finset.prod_erase_mul _ _ hi]; unfold f'; rw [if_pos rfl]; simp only [leftDerivs, smul_eq_mul]; congr 1
      exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j hj => by rw [if_neg (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj)]
    rw [Work.G07.left_append,left_congr l U ht,left_sum _ _ U l (fun i hi => chart_prod s (f' i) (hx i hi)) le_rfl]
    have hcost (i : ι) (hi : i∈s) := ih (f' i) (hx i hi) (by
      intro j hj l' hl' hD'; unfold f'; split
      · rename_i he; subst j; rw [← Work.G07.left_append]; exact hc _ hj _ (by simp; omega) (by
          intro v hv; obtain hh|hh := List.mem_append.mp hv
          · exact hD' _ hh
          exact hD _ (List.mem_append_right _ hh))
      exact hc _ hj _ (by omega) hD') le_rfl (fun v hv => hD v (by simp [hv]))
    apply (norm_sum_le ..).trans
    exact (Finset.sum_le_sum hcost).trans_eq (by rw [Finset.sum_const]; simp; ring)

theorem line_budget {w : ℝ} {f : Config G n → ℂ} {C : ℝ} (hb : ∀ U, ‖f U‖ ≤ C)
    (hv : R.activities.KBound R.p w) :
    ∃ p : ℕ → ℝ, SumBudget (fun i => R.p.mass (X R i) (p i))
         (C * (R.p.mass Y 1 * (Real.exp (Y.card*w)-1))) ∧
      ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i ∧ ∀ U, ‖line R Y H q f i U‖ ≤ p i := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hw⟩ := hv
  let s := stamp R Y H q
  let g (c : Cluster R Y) := C * ∏ i ∈ c.val,a i
  let p : ℕ → ℝ := extend s g (fun _ => 0)
  have hc : 0 ≤ C := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hb 1)
  have he (c) : p (s c) = g c := s.injective.extend_apply ..
  have hz (i : ℕ) (hi : i∉range s) : p i = 0 := extend_apply' _ _ _ hi
  have hh (i) : 0 ≤ p i ∧ ∀ U, ‖line R Y H q f i U‖ ≤ p i := by
    by_cases ht : i ∈ range s
    · obtain ⟨c,rfl⟩ := ht
      have hy : 0 ≤ g c := mul_nonneg hc (Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ => (ha j).1)
      refine ⟨(he c).symm ▸ hy,fun U => ?_⟩
      rw [he,show line R Y H q f (s c) = _ from line_stamp ..]
      unfold chunk
      split
      · rw [norm_mul,norm_prod]
        exact mul_le_mul (hb U) (Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _) fun i _ =>
          (Complex.norm_real _).trans_le ((ha i).2 U)) (Finset.prod_nonneg fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _) hc
      rw [norm_zero]; exact hy
    simp [hz _ ht, line_empty _ _ _ _ _ ht]
  refine ⟨p,?_,hh⟩
  let k := fun i => R.p.mass (X R i) (p i)
  have ht : SumBudget (k ∘ s) (C * (R.p.mass Y 1 * (Real.exp (Y.card*w)-1))) := by
    have ht := budget_scale (budget_cluster R Y (fun i => (ha i).1) hw) hc
    have hx (c : Cluster R Y) : (k ∘ s) c = C * R.p.mass (span R Y c) (∏ i∈c.val, a i) := by
      unfold comp k
      rw [he,show X R (s c)=_ from stamp_x ..]; exact mass_scale ..
    exact (funext hx).symm ▸ ht
  have hj i (hi : i∉range s) : k i=0 := by simp [k,BudgetPoint.mass,hz i hi]
  refine ⟨fun i => mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (hh i).1,(s.injective.summable_iff hj).mp ht.2.1,?_⟩
  have hg : Function.support k ⊆ range s := by
    intro i hi
    by_contra he
    exact hi (hj _ he)
  exact (s.injective.tsum_eq hg).symm.trans_le ht.2.2

lemma supplement_bound (h : S.Sound A) {B : ℝ} (hb : 1 ≤ B)
    (ht : ∀ (i : F.Index) U, ‖S.places (Size.axis F i) o U‖ ≤ B) (v : F.Coeff) (U) :
    ‖supplement S R o v U‖ ≤ fullCost F R.p B * F.coeffSize (F.core v) := by
  have hB := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hb
  let z := F.scaled R.p.threshold⁻¹ (F.core v)
  have h0 := R.p.threshold_pos
  have hQ : 0 ≤ fullCost F R.p B := by unfold fullCost; positivity
  by_cases hh : Healthy R.p.threshold (S.footprint o) U
  · rw [healthy_supplement S R o h v _ hh,norm_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg hQ (Work.G08.size_nonneg ..)
  have ht' : supplement S R o v U = S.places z o U := by
    simp only [supplement,part,LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk,masked_ne _ _ _ _ hh]
    nth_rw 1 [← Size.core_plus F v]
    simp only [map_add,map_smul,SectionData.places,S.eval_linear.map_add, Frame.scaled_unit,
      S.eval_linear.map_smul,Pi.add_apply,h.unit,Pi.one_apply,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul]; unfold z; ring
  rw [ht']
  let f : F.Coeff →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ := {
    toFun i := S.places i o U
    map_add' a b := congr_fun (S.eval_linear.map_add a b) (expandAt o U)
    map_smul' a b := congr_fun (S.eval_linear.map_smul a b) (expandAt o U) }
  have hz i : ‖z i‖ ≤ R.p.threshold⁻¹^(degree F) * ‖F.core v i‖ := by
    have hh : 1 ≤ R.p.threshold⁻¹ := (one_le_inv₀ h0).mpr R.p.threshold_le
    have he : (F.grades i).2 ≤ degree F := Finset.le_sup (f:=fun i => (F.grades i).2) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    unfold z
    rw [F.scaled_apply,norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_right₀ hh he) (norm_nonneg _)
  calc
    _ = ‖∑ i, z i • f (Size.axis F i)‖ := by simp_rw [← map_smul,← map_sum,Size.sum_axes]; rfl
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ‖z i • f (Size.axis F i)‖ := norm_sum_le ..
    _ ≤ ∑ i, fullCost F R.p B * ‖F.core v i‖ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => by
      rw [norm_smul]; refine (mul_le_mul (hz i) (ht i U) (norm_nonneg _)
        ((norm_nonneg _).trans (hz i))).trans_eq ?_; unfold fullCost; ring
    _ = _ := by rw [Frame.coeffSize,Finset.mul_sum]

private theorem max_end (g : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (hn : ∀ i, i ≤ m → 0 ≤ g i) (A : ℝ)
    (H : ∀ i, i+2 ≤ m → g (i+1)^2 ≤ g i*g (i+2)) (h : g 0 ≤ A) (he : g m≤A) : ∀ i ≤ m, g i ≤ A := by
  -- strict increase propagates
  have hv i (hp : i+1 ≤ m) (hr : g i < g (i+1)) : g (i+1) ≤ A := by
    have he_idx (p : ℕ) (hr' : g p<g (p+1)) (hs : p+2≤m) : g (p+1)<g (p+2) := by
      have hl := H p hs
      have ha := hn p (by omega)
      have hh := hn (p+2) hs
      by_contra! hv
      apply (not_le.mpr ?_ hl)
      calc _ ≤ g p * g (p+1) := by gcongr
           _ < _ := by nlinarith
    have ht (q : ℕ) (hq : i≤q) (hz : q+1≤m) : g q<g (q+1) ∧ g (i+1) ≤ g (q+1) := by
      induction q, hq using Nat.le_induction with
      | base => exact ⟨hr,le_rfl⟩
      | succ n hn ih => exact ⟨he_idx _ (ih (by omega)).1 hz,(ih (by omega)).2.trans (he_idx _ (ih (by omega)).1 hz).le⟩
    have hs : g (i+1) ≤ g ((m-1)+1) := (ht _ (by omega) (by omega)).2
    rw [show m-1+1=m by omega] at hs; exact hs.trans he
  intro i hi; induction i with
  | zero => exact h
  | succ i ih => exact le_or_gt (g (i+1)) (g i) |>.elim (fun h => h.trans (ih (by omega))) (fun h => hv i hi h)
ends.conclusion: A nonnegative sequence with g(i+1)^2 <= g(i) g(i+2) on a finite interval is bounded by the maximum of its endpoint values.

lemma torus_kernel (x : Site n) :
    ∑ y : Site n, Real.exp (-(separation y x : ℝ) / (4*(M:ℝ)+2)) ≤ (2*(16*(M:ℝ)+9))^4 := by
  let t y := lift (y-x)
  have hi : Injective t := fun y z h => by
    have := congr_arg (wrap n) h
    simpa only [t,wrap_lift, sub_left_inj] using this
  let b := ((4:ℝ)*(4*M+2))⁻¹
  have hp : 0 < b := by unfold b; positivity
  have he (y : Site n) : Laurent.size (t y) ≤ 4*separation y x := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : Axis, separation y x := sum_le_sum fun i _ => component_le _ _
      _ = _ := by simp [Axis]
  have hn := Laurent.Width.compactPay (α:=Axis) b hp
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ y, Real.exp (-b*Laurent.size (t y)) := sum_le_sum fun i _ => Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by
      have h : (Laurent.size (t i):ℝ) ≤ 4*(separation i x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast he i
      change -_/_ ≤ -((4:ℝ)*(4*M+2))⁻¹*_
      field_simp; linarith)
    _ = ∑ y∈univ.image t, Real.exp (-b*Laurent.size y) := by rw [sum_image hi.injOn]
    _ ≤ (2*((1+b)/b))^(Fintype.card Axis) := Budget.cap hn _
    _ = _ := by simp [Axis,b]; congr 1; field_simp; ring
ends.conclusion: The kernel sum is bounded on the periodic lattice, uniformly in the period, by an injective lift of `y - x` into the infinite lattice.

        rw [if_pos h.1,show p v i = _ from if_pos hv,mul_comm (f i),← mul_assoc]
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (hf i)
        rw [show k (o v)=_ from rfl, ← Real.exp_add, Real.exp_le_exp]
        have he : (separation (o v) x : ℝ) ≤ coverNumber M (X i) * (4*(M:ℝ)+2)+2*(M:ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast Corona.extent _ _ hw h.1
        have hp : 0 < (4*(M:ℝ)+2) := by positivity

private lemma cone_step_arith {K q e a b u v y r t : ℝ} (hk : 1 ≤ K)
    (he : 0 ≤ e) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (ha : 4*K^2 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hp : 4*K*e ≤ 1) (hp' : 4*K*b*e ≤ 1) (hrent : (4*K^2+1)*(q*e) ≤ 1)
    (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hcone : a*u ≤ r) (hinv : y ≤ K*(u+e*(y+t))) (hh : v ≤ y) (hr : r ≤ K*y+e*t) :
    b*v ≤ t ∧ q*r ≤ t := by
  have hk' : 0 < K := by linarith
  have hm : e*t ≤ K*(e*t) := le_mul_of_one_le_left (mul_nonneg he ht) hk
  -- The leakage from the preceding level through u is already tiny.
  have hx : 4*K*u ≤ y+e*t := by
    apply le_of_mul_le_mul_left _ hk'
    calc
      K*(4*K*u) = (4*K^2)*u := by ring
      _ ≤ a*u := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha hu
      _ ≤ K*y+e*t := hcone.trans hr
      _ ≤ K*(y+e*t) := by rw [mul_add]; exact add_le_add le_rfl hm
  have hd : y ≤ 4*K*e*t := by
    linarith only [hx, hinv, hm, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp hy, mul_nonneg he ht]
ends.conclusion: From `a*u ≤ r`, `4K^2 ≤ a`, the two marked-step inequalities and `4K*e ≤ 1`, `cone_step_arith` derives `4K*u ≤ y + e*t` (`hx`) and then `y ≤ 4K*e*t` (`hd`).

proof_context.conclusion: From `a*u ≤ r`, `4K^2 ≤ a`, the two marked-step inequalities and `4K*e ≤ 1`, `cone_step_arith` derives `4K*u ≤ y + e*t` (`hx`) and then `y ≤ 4K*e*t` (`hd`).

theorem scanner_inj (d : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis ι ℂ (W d)) (x y : E4) (hx : x≠y) :

  let B := readsTwo F d x y

    (reflected_positive hx _).2 (by rw [map_sub]; exact sub_ne_zero.mpr ((writes_inj F d).ne h))

  rw [← hp] at he; simp at he

private lemma realPrice {A B C D E F J K : X → ℂ}
    (ha : Envelope A) (hb : Envelope B) (hc : Envelope C) (hd : Envelope D)
    (he : Envelope E) (hf : Envelope F) (hj : Envelope J) (hk : Envelope K)
    (hp : ∀ x, star ((A-B) x) = (A-B) x) {a b c d : ℝ}
    (h₁ : ‖bi μ A C - bi μ E J‖ ≤ a) (h₂ : ‖bi μ A D - bi μ E K‖ ≤ b)
    (h₃ : ‖bi μ B C - bi μ F J‖ ≤ c) (h₄ : ‖bi μ B D - bi μ F K‖ ≤ d) :
    |(∫ x, ((A-B) x).re * ((C-D) x).re ∂μ) - ∫ x, ((E x-F x)*(J x-K x)).re ∂μ| ≤ (a+b)+(c+d) := by
  have ht {A B C D : X → ℂ} (ha : Envelope A) (hb : Envelope B) (hc : Envelope C) (hd : Envelope D) :
      (∫ x, ((A x-B x)*(C x-D x)).re ∂μ) = (bi μ (A-B) (C-D)).re :=
    integral_re (((ha.subC hb).mulC (hc.subC hd)).integrableC μ)
  have hl (x) : ((A-B) x).re * ((C-D) x).re=((A x-B x)*(C x-D x)).re := by
    have hh : ↑((A-B) x).re=((A-B) x) := Complex.conj_eq_iff_re.mp (hp x)
    change _ = (((A-B) x)*((C-D) x)).re; conv_rhs => rw [← hh]
    simp
  simp_rw [hl]; rw [ht ha hb hc hd,ht he hf hj hk, ← Complex.sub_re]
  apply (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans
  rw [swapped μ A B C D ha hb hc hd,swapped μ E F J K he hf hj hk]
  rw [show (bi μ A C- _ - (bi μ B C- _)) - (bi μ E J-bi μ E K-(bi μ F J-bi μ F K))=
      (bi μ A C-bi μ E J)-(bi μ A D-bi μ E K) - ((bi μ B C-bi μ F J)-(bi μ B D-bi μ F K)) by abel]
  exact (norm_sub_le ..).trans (add_le_add ((norm_sub_le ..).trans (add_le_add h₁ h₂))
    ((norm_sub_le ..).trans (add_le_add h₃ h₄)))

private lemma extendsBound (H : Bound C f) {n : ℕ} {P} (Hp : f.Meshes C P) (v : Fin n → C.book.Token) {x}
    (hx : x ∈ generic n) : ∃ D : ℝ, ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ‖(P (f.per i)).read x v‖ ≤ D := by
  obtain ⟨K,hk,hI,hU⟩ := exists_compact_subset (genericOpen n) hx
  obtain ⟨R,hR,H⟩ := H.volume n v K hk (Subset.trans hU (generic_conf _))
  refine ⟨R,?_⟩
  unfold Order.late at H
  have ht := (chosen (S := C.S) x).comp f.mesh.cofinal
  filter_upwards [H, f.per.cofinal.eventually (room C.S hk)] with i hi hr
  let p := f.per i
  have he : x ∈ Cyclic C.S p n := (no_wrap_tie C.S (hr (interior_subset hI))).2 hx
  have hh := f.evaluated C Hp p n v x he (fun i => address (C.S.a (f.mesh i)) x) ht
  refine le_of_tendsto hh.norm ?_
  filter_upwards [hi,ht.eventually (mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mp hI)] with j h hk
  exact h _ hk

lemma volume_oscillates (H : TransferLip C f) (n : ℕ) {P} (Hp : f.Meshes C P) (v : Fin n → C.book.Token) :
    oscillation (generic n) (fun i x => (P (f.per i)).read x v) := by
  intro K hU hk ε hε
  obtain ⟨T,hT,hKT,hTg⟩ := exists_compact_between hk (genericOpen n) hU
  obtain ⟨d,hd,H⟩ := H.expanding n _ hT hTg v (ε/2) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨d,hd,?_⟩
  unfold Order.late at H
  filter_upwards [H, f.per.cofinal.eventually (room C.S hT)] with i hi hr x hx y hy hD
  let p := f.per i
  have he (x : Points n) (hx : x ∈ K) : x ∈ Cyclic C.S p n :=
    (no_wrap_tie C.S (hr (interior_subset (hKT hx)))).mpr (hU hx)
  let a (j : ℕ) := C.S.a (f.mesh j)
  let r (x : Points n) (j : ℕ) := address (a j) x
  let w j := tag (a j) (n := n)
  have hu (x) : Tendsto (fun i => w i (r x i)) atTop (𝓝 x) := (chosen (S := C.S) x).comp f.mesh.cofinal
  have hh (x hx) := f.evaluated C Hp p n v x (he x hx) (r x) (hu x)
  have ht : dist ((P (f.per i)).read x v) ((P (f.per i)).read y v) ≤ ε/2 := by
    apply le_of_tendsto ((hh x hx).dist (hh y hy))
    have hp := ((hu x).dist (hu y)).eventually (gt_mem_nhds hD)
    filter_upwards [hi, hp,(hu x).eventually (mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mp (hKT hx)),
      (hu y).eventually (mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mp (hKT hy))] with j ht hu hv hw
    exact (ht (r x j) (r y j) hv hw hu).le
  linarith

theorem first_surface (H : TransferLip C f) (h : Bound C f) :
    ∃ g : Order, ∃ S P, RawLimits C (f.refine g) S P := by
  obtain ⟨t,P,hP⟩ := setMeshes C f H h
  let w := f.refine (meshMore t)
  let F (p : Indices C.book) (j) (x) := (P (w.per j)).read x (stack p)
  obtain ⟨u,v,hu⟩ := localAscoli (fun i : Indices C.book => Points i.1) (fun i => generic i.1) (fun i => genericOpen _)
    F (fun p => volume_oscillates _ _ (further _ _ H _) p.1 hP (stack p))
    (fun p x hx => extendsBound _ _ (h.further _) hP _ hx)
  let g := Order.mk t u
  let S := fitted v
  have Hs (n) (p : Fin n → C.book.Token) : Meets (generic n)
      (fun i x => (P ((f.refine g).per i)).read x p) (fun x => S.read x p) := by
    apply components S (fun i => P _) generic _ n p
    intro i; simpa only [S,knobs] using! hu i
  have hm : (f.refine g).Meshes C P := ⟨hP.continuous,hP.onK⟩
  have hV : (f.refine g).VolumePoints C S P := by
    intro n K hk he v ε hε
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using (Hs n v).uniform K he hk ε hε
  exact ⟨g,S,P,⟨fun n p => (Hs n p).continuousOn,hm,hV, Order.poses _ _ (h.further g) ⟨P,hm,hV⟩⟩⟩

private lemma cost_limit (T : YM.Bid.D01) (W : YM.Bid.D02) (h : C.Makes)

    {x : Rowe C e} (hx : dollar C F x) (i : Shot C.book) :
    Tendsto (fun u => snapshots i e u (x u - (R e).step u (x u)) /
      (1 + (↑‖(R e).step u (x u)‖ : ℂ))) F.fuse (𝓝 0) := by
  let p : Rowe C e := fun u => (R e).step u (x u)
  let a (j : ℕ × ℕ) := (1+‖p j‖)⁻¹
  let b (j : ℕ × ℕ) := (↑(a j) : ℂ)
  let z : Rowe C e := fun j => b j • (x j-p j)
  have hn (j) : ‖b j‖ = (1+‖p j‖)⁻¹ := by
    unfold b a
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  have hb (j) : ‖b j‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hn, ← one_div]
    exact (div_le_one (by positivity)).mpr (by simp)
  have ht : tight C F (d := e) (fun j => b j • p j) := by
    refine ⟨1,?_⟩
    apply (Order.fused F (fun j => ‖b j • p j‖ ≤ 1)).mp
    refine Eventually.of_forall fun j => ?_
    rw [norm_smul, hn, mul_comm, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact (div_le_one (by positivity)).mpr (by linarith)
  have hz : dollar C F z := by
    have he := dollar_sub (dollar_shrink hx b hb) (T C h e F _ ht)
    simpa only [z, smul_sub] using he
  have hk (j) : (R e).step j (z j) = 0 := by
    simp only [z, p, map_smul, map_sub, (R e).projection, sub_self, smul_zero]
  apply (marked_silent W h c R H z hk hz i).congr'
  filter_upwards with j
  rw [show z j=_ • (x j-p j) from rfl,map_smul,smul_eq_mul]
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv,mul_comm, show b j = (↑((1+‖p j‖)⁻¹) : ℂ) from rfl,
    Complex.ofReal_inv, Complex.ofReal_add, Complex.ofReal_one]

theorem compat (hs : S.Smooth) (h : S.Symmetric) (H : S.RealSpin) (P : DiffPlan S)
    (hd : P.Derivatives S) (hu : P.Inclusions S) : P.Orientation H where
  realInc e B := by
    apply real_ext h H; intro n q x hx
    rw [hu.kernels e _ hx, real_front h H B hx, hu.kernels e B hx]
  realDer d a B := by
    apply real_ext h H; intro n q x hx
    rw [hd.kernels _ _ _ hx, hd.kernels d a B hx, ← gradient_star]
    apply GermD
    filter_upwards [(conf_open _).mem_nhds hx] with y hy
    exact real_front h H B hy q
  mirrorInc e s B := by
    apply signed_ext h H s; intro n q x hx
    rw [hu.kernels e _ (move_in _ hx), signed_front h H B s hx, hu.kernels e B hx]
  mirrorDer d b s B := by
    apply signed_ext h H s; intro n q x hx
    let t := signedTag H s ∘ q
    let B' := S.mirror H d s B
    let u : Fin (n+1) → S.Tag := Fin.cons ⟨d,B'⟩ t
    let f z := S.useAt S z u
    let y := move s.ortho x
    have hy : y ∈ conf _ := move_in _ hx
    let m := Ward.here u y 0 (d+1)
    have em (p : S.Field (d+1)) : m p = S.useAt S y (Fin.cons ⟨d+1,p⟩ t) := by
      rw [show m p = _ from Ward.takes u y 0 (d+1) p, Fin.update_cons_zero]; rfl
    change S.useAt S y _ = _
    rw [← em, map_sum]
    have hf := (((S.class_smooth S hs u) y hy).contDiffAt ((conf_open _).mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    calc
      _ = ∑ a, s.ortho.val a b • gradient 0 a f y := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro a _
        rw [map_smul, em, hd.kernels d a B' hy,Complex.real_smul]; rfl
      _ = gradient 0 b (f ∘ move s.ortho) x := (gradient_move _ _ b f x hf).symm
      _ = gradient 0 b (fun z => S.useAt S z (Fin.cons ⟨d,B⟩ q)) x := by
        apply GermD
        filter_upwards [(conf_open _).mem_nhds hx] with z hz
        exact signed_front h H B s hz q
      _ = _ := (hd.kernels d b B hx q).symm
ends.conclusion: `Orientation`: inclusions and derivatives commute with conjugation and signed permutations, with `mirrorDer d b s B = sum_a s.ortho a b * deriv d a (mirror B)`.

theorem hosting (G : Gauge) (j : ℕ) : ∃ d, ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : WickPol G), p∈shelf G j → Pure k p → Painted p → p ∈ Host G d k := by
  classical
  let R := ↥(Rack G j)
  letI := finstock G j
  let V : Set R := {p|∃ k : ℕ,0< k ∧ Pure k p.val ∧ Painted p.val}
  let W : Submodule R R := Submodule.span R V
  obtain ⟨s,hs,h⟩ := (Submodule.fg_span_iff_fg_span_finset_subset (R:=R) V).mp (show W.FG from IsNoetherian.noetherian _)
  choose L hL using (fun p : R => cap_exists p.val)
  let d := s.sup L
  refine ⟨d,?_⟩
  intro k
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h k ih =>
    intro p hp hK H
    by_cases ht : k=0
    · subst k; rw [bulk_zero p hK]
      have h : (1:WickPol G)∈ Host G d 0 := by
        apply Submodule.subset_span; exact ⟨0,fun _ => 0,fun _ => 1, isEmptyElim,by simp,by simp⟩
      nth_rw 1 [← mul_one (C _)]; rw [C_mul']; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h
    let u : R := ⟨p,hp⟩

    let s := Signed.reflect timeAxis
    let K := mirrorBar s P

      rw [show s*s=1 by unfold s; nth_rw 1 [← mirrored_inv timeAxis]; exact inv_mul_cancel _,pol_one]

        exact (by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_lt ht : (s:ℝ)+2≠r)

      have he : g =ᶠ[𝓝 x] rad (s+1) • f := (show EqOn g _ away from fun y h => (hv y h).symm).eventuallyEq_of_mem (open_away.mem_nhds hx)

  obtain ⟨g,hg,hv⟩ := he S (by omega)
  intro x hx
  let y (t : ℝ) := t • x
  have ht : Tendsto id little (𝓝 (0:ℝ)) := tendsto_id.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hm := (ht.pow r).smul ((hg.continuous.continuousAt (x:=(0:ℝ) • x)).tendsto.comp (ht.smul tendsto_const_nhds))
  rw [zero_pow (n:=r) (by omega),zero_smul] at hm
  have hv : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ => f x) little (𝓝 0) := by

lemma scenes_gone (t : Vector d (Model F)) : (∀ s : Scene (Model F) d, s.lens t=0) ↔ quiet F t := by
  constructor
  · intro v n a p x hx
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := exists_ne a
    obtain ⟨y,hy,hA,h⟩ := to_scanner hx b
    let f := diagram p (t a)
    have hh (m) (B : Fin m → Points n) : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f y B=0 := v ⟨n,p,b,a,hb.symm,y,hy,hA,m,B⟩
    have hg : f =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := by
      obtain ⟨P,r,hP⟩ := lenses F p _ y hy
      have hw : Tendsto (fun z : Points n => z-y) (𝓝 y) (𝓝 0) := by
        simpa only [id_eq,sub_self] using (tendsto_id (x:=𝓝 y)).sub (tendsto_const_nhds (x:=y))
      filter_upwards [hw.eventually (Metric.eball_mem_nhds _ hP.r_pos)] with z hz
      change z-y ∈ Metric.eball _ _ at hz
      have hl := hP.hasSum_iteratedFDeriv hz
      change HasSum (fun i => ((↑(i.factorial):ℝ)⁻¹) • iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f y fun _=> z - y) _ at hl
      simp_rw [hh,smul_zero,add_sub_cancel] at hl
      exact hl.unique hasSum_zero
    exact ((lenses F p _).mono h).eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero (convex_segment .. |>.isPreconnected) (left_mem_segment ..) hg (right_mem_segment ..)
  intro H s
  have h : diagram s.v (t s.b)=ᶠ[𝓝 s.x] 0 := (show EqOn _ _ (conf s.n) from fun x hx => H _ _ _ _ hx).eventuallyEq_of_mem ((conf_open _).mem_nhds s.strict)

private lemma to_scanner {x : Points n} (hx : x∈conf _) (a : Axis) : ∃ y∈conf n,onLine a y ∧ segment ℝ y x ⊆ conf _ := by
  obtain ⟨p,hp,hA⟩ := tiesAway (fun i => x i a)
  let y := points fun i => p i • basis a
  have he : y∈conf n := fun i j h => hp (smul_left_injective ℝ (show basis a≠0 from norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (by simp)) h)
  refine ⟨y,he,fun i => ⟨p i,rfl⟩,?_⟩
  rintro z ⟨u,t,hu,hW,h,rfl⟩
  by_cases ho : u=0
  · rw [ho,zero_add] at h; rw [ho,h,zero_smul,one_smul,zero_add]; exact hx
  by_cases hv : t=0
  · rw [hv,add_zero] at h; rw [hv,h,zero_smul,one_smul,add_zero]; exact he
  have hh (i : Fin n) : (u • y+t • x) i a = u*p i+t*x i a := by simp [y]
  intro i j hi
  have ht : (u • y+t • x) i a=(u • y+t • x) j a := congr_arg (fun x : E4 => x a) hi
  rw [hh,hh] at ht
  rcases lt_trichotomy (x i a) (x j a) with H|H|H
  · have h := hA i j H
    exact ((add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h (lt_of_le_of_ne hu (Ne.symm ho))) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H.le hW)).ne ht).elim
  · rw [H] at ht; exact hp (mul_left_cancel₀ ho (add_right_cancel ht))
  have h := hA j i H
  exact ((add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h (lt_of_le_of_ne hu (Ne.symm ho))) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left H.le hW)).ne ht.symm).elim

  let K s := LinearMap.ker (Work.A06.lensL (S:=Model F) (d:=d) (hierarchy F) s).toLinearMap

  obtain ⟨S,hS⟩ : R (Nat.find hr) := Nat.find_spec hr
  have he : V S= ⨅ s, K s := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply le_iInf; intro s

        unfold V; apply le_iInf; intro i; apply le_iInf; intro h

theorem none {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℝ M]
    (T : Ortho.Skew →ₗ[ℝ] Ortho.Skew →ₗ[ℝ] M) (h : ∀ u,T u u=0) (hp : ∀ a b (u v : Ortho.Skew), a≠b →
      T (orients (quarter a b) u) (orients (quarter a b) v)=T u v) : T=0 := by
  have halt (u v) : T v u= - T u v := by
    have he := h (u+v); simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, h, add_zero,zero_add] at he
    exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left he
  have hz {x : M} (hx : x= -x) : x=0 := by
    apply (smul_right_injective M (by norm_num : (2:ℝ)≠0));
    change (2:ℝ) • x = (2:ℝ) • 0; rw [two_smul,smul_zero]; nth_rw 1 [hx]; simp
  have ht (a b c : Axis) (ha : a≠b) (hb : a≠c) : T (Ortho.plane a b) (Ortho.plane a c)=0 := by
    by_cases hk : b=c
    · subst c; exact h _
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hv, hi⟩ : ∃ d : Axis,d≠a ∧ d≠b ∧ d≠c := by
      exact (show ∀ i j k : Fin 4, ∃ l : Fin 4, l≠i ∧ l≠j ∧ l≠k from by decide) a b c
    let s := quarter c d * quarter c d
    have hs (i j) : orients s (Ortho.plane i j) = _ := bracket_orient s i j
    apply hz
    conv_lhs => rw [← show T (orients s (Ortho.plane a b)) (orients s (Ortho.plane a c)) = _ from commute_inv_apply T hp c d hi.symm a b a c]
    simp only [hs]
    simp [s, quarter,Equiv.swap_apply_def,hb,hd,hv,hi,hk,Ne.symm]
  have hd (a b i l : Axis) (hab : a ≠ b) (hai : a≠i) (hal : a≠l) (hbi : b≠i) (hbl : b≠l) (hil : i≠l) :
      T (Ortho.plane a b) (Ortho.plane i l)=0 := by
    apply hz
    conv_lhs => rw [← hp a i _ _ hai]
    have heta : orients (quarter a i) (Ortho.plane a b)= -Ortho.plane i b := by rw [bracket_orient]; simp [quarter,Equiv.swap_apply_def,hab,hbi,Ne.symm]; exact neg_one_smul ℝ (Ortho.plane i b)
    have heib : orients (quarter a i) (Ortho.plane i l)= Ortho.plane a l := by rw [bracket_orient]; simp [quarter,Equiv.swap_apply_def,hai,hal,hil,Ne.symm]
    rw [heta,heib,map_neg,LinearMap.neg_apply]; congr 1
    conv_lhs => rw [← hp b l _ _ hbl]
    have Hta : orients (quarter b l) (Ortho.plane i b)= -Ortho.plane i l := by rw [bracket_orient]; simp [quarter,Equiv.swap_apply_def,hbi,hil,Ne.symm]; exact neg_one_smul ℝ (Ortho.plane i l)
    have Htz : orients (quarter b l) (Ortho.plane a l)= Ortho.plane a b := by rw [bracket_orient]; simp [quarter,Equiv.swap_apply_def,hab,hal,hbl,Ne.symm]
    rw [Hta,Htz,map_neg,LinearMap.neg_apply,halt (Ortho.plane a b), neg_neg]
  have hh (a b : Axis) : Ortho.plane b a = -Ortho.plane a b := Subtype.ext (neg_sub _ _).symm
  have hk (a b i l : Axis) : T (Ortho.plane a b) (Ortho.plane i l)=0 := by
    have hu (a) : Ortho.plane a a=0 := Subtype.ext (sub_self _)
    rcases eq_or_ne a b with he|he
    · subst b; simp [hu]
    rcases eq_or_ne i l with h1|h1
    · subst l; simp [hu]
    by_cases h' : a=i
    · subst i; exact ht a b l he h1
    by_cases h'' : a=l
    · subst l; rw [hh a i]; simp only [map_neg,ht a b i he h1.symm,neg_zero]
    by_cases hb : b=i
    · subst i; rw [hh b a]; simp only [map_neg,LinearMap.neg_apply,ht b a l he.symm h1, neg_zero]
    by_cases hl : b=l
    · subst l; rw [hh b a,hh b i]; simp only [map_neg,LinearMap.neg_apply,ht b a i he.symm h1.symm,neg_zero]
    exact hd a b i l he h' h'' hb hl h1
  apply LinearMap.ext_on Spin.spans; rintro x ⟨p,rfl⟩; apply LinearMap.ext_on Spin.spans; rintro y ⟨q,rfl⟩; exact hk ..
ends.conclusion: An alternating bilinear map on skew matrices invariant under all quarter-turn orientations is zero (overlapping planes and disjoint planes handled separately).

    (h : ∀ u p,(gear F).lie d u (T p)=T ((gear F).lie d u p))

  let u := Ortho.plane i j
  let f := fun s => (gear F).act d (oneParameter u s)
  let A t := f t (T p)
  let C t := T (f t p)
  let M := ((gear F).lie d u).toContinuousLinearMap

    change HasDerivAt C ((gear F).lie d u (T _)) s
    rw [h]; exact L.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s (circle_ode F u p s)
  rw [Corners.sendsTime i j he]

theorem commute_ghost {L : Engine G 0} {T : Module.End ℂ (WickPol G)} (hd : 4≤d) (H : silence G d T)
    (ht : ∀ a b, T (polStress G a b)=0)
    (HL : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : Points (n+1)), x∈conf _ → ∃ χ v, Table.Window x χ ∧ Motion (x:=x 0) v L χ)
    (p : WickPol G) (hp : p∈shellSector G d) (he : rewired L p∈shellSector G d) :
    rewired L (T p) - T (rewired L p) ∈ ghost G d := by
  intro n q x hq hx
  classical
  obtain ⟨χ,v,w,Hv⟩ := HL n x hx
  let B (p : WickPol G) := Fin.cons (α:=fun _ : Fin (n+1) => WickPol G) p q
  let f (i : Fin (n+1)) := update (B p) i (T (B p i))
  let R (i) := stressRead x v (f i)
  have hh : exportFlux (fun a y => ∑ i, R i a y) χ=0 := by
    rw [flux_invariant χ _ 0]
    · simp [exportFlux]
    intro a y hy
    have hu := Work.A01.window_separated hx w hy
    unfold R stressRead; rw [Finset.sum_comm];
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun b _ => ?_
    rw [← Finset.smul_sum];
    suffices hr : (∑ i, bookend x y (f i) (polStress G a b))=0 by rw [hr, smul_zero]
    have hm (i : Fin (n+1)) : B p i ∈ shellSector G d := Fin.cases hp hq i
    have ha := H _ (Fin.cons (α:=fun _ => WickPol G) (polStress G a b) (B p)) (Points.cons y x)
      (fun i => Fin.cases (chain hd (stress_label G a b)) hm i) hu
    conv at ha => lhs; rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    simp only [Fin.cons_zero, ht] at ha
    rw [show moment G (Points.cons y x) (update (Fin.cons (α:=fun _ => WickPol G) (polStress G a b) (B p)) 0 0)=0 from
      MultilinearMap.map_coord_zero _ 0 (Function.update_self _ _ _),zero_add] at ha; refine Eq.trans ?_ ha
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _
    rw [book_eval,Fin.cons_succ]; congr 1
    exact Fin.cons_update ..
  rw [flux_series w.1 w.2.1] at hh
  · simp_rw [R,moment_force hx w Hv,Finset.sum_neg_distrib,neg_eq_zero] at hh
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at hh

lemma shrink_min (h : C.Makes) (hk : k≤N) (p : ℕ) : (shrink C k N p)⁻¹ ≤ 2*C.path.levels.clock.monitor k := by
  let A := C.path.levels.clock; let B := A.hatBeta k; let t:= A.threshold k
  have he : 0<t := (C.path.levels.budget k).threshold_pos
  have hx : 0<B := lt_trans zero_lt_one (C.path.levels.fits.delayed k)
  have hp : 0 < C.path.β N p k := Overlay.beta_positive h.wilson hk
  have hc : C.path.β N p k ≤ 2*B := (h.wilson.represents N p k hk).band.2
  calc
    _ = t * Real.sqrt (C.path.β N p k) := by unfold shrink; simp only [inv_div,div_inv_eq_mul];rfl
    _ ≤ t * (2 * Real.sqrt B) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ he.le
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg B,Real.sq_sqrt hp.le,Real.sq_sqrt hx.le]
    _ = _ := by
      change ((Real.sqrt B)⁻¹ * (A.monitor k)) * _ = 2 * A.monitor k
      have he := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hx; field_simp
ends.conclusion: `shrink_min` proves `(shrink)⁻¹ ≤ 2 * monitor k` from the band `β ≤ 2 * hatBeta k` and `threshold = hatCoupling * monitor`.

lemma crushed (hp : Period b w degree x k) (g : Fit C.path.levels b k x) {T' : C.label d→ₗ[ℂ] C.label d} (hV : Heating C k N p d degree V T')

    (hb : Bell C.path.levels X d degree g) (D : Demand) (slot : ℕ) (h : Clipped b X V c Y x t hi degree D slot) :
    Arrangements hi c Y (joint w) (asked t) g D slot := by
  let A := C.path.levels; let T:= Ship.yard C b hi p; let S := clim A k
  let f:= Ship.targets C (joint w) g
  intro hv hs; obtain ⟨α,β,bα,bβ,H,K,W,h1,hbg,h2,h3,h4⟩ := h hv hs
  refine ⟨α,β,bα,bβ,H,K,W,h1,hbg,h2,fun i => ⟨(h3 i).1,(h3 i).2,fun U HH => ?_⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨y,hy,hh⟩ := h4 i.1 U HH
  obtain ⟨hc,hp⟩ := hp; obtain ⟨Q,L⟩ := hp g
  let u:= Station.choose A b k x

  have he : ‖D'-f‖+bill (-3/2) S ≤ bill (-31/32) S := L _ _ _ (cumulates X V u (before A b k) t y)
    (Read.cumulative C (Station.tested A b k x) (joint w) (Ship.fitting g)) (fun s => sizes w g degree hi hV hb y hy hc t ht Q s)
  let v:= (W i).value U; let z:= Peak.view T f i; let a:= (Array.reorient T i.1 D').part i.2.val
  change ‖v+z‖ ≤ _
  rw [show v+z=(a+z)+(v-a) by ring]; exact (norm_add_le ..).trans ((add_le_add (honor (C:=C) i.1 _ _ i.2) (hh _)).trans he)

lemma warming {ζ : Site (A.S.side (width A b k) p) × Fin v → Site (A.S.side (middle A b k) p)}
    {W : Site (A.S.side (width A b k) p) × flame (Fin v) → SourceAt G ζ}
    {C : Site (A.S.side (width A b k) p) × flame (Fin v) → ℂ}
    (hv : v ≤ m) (hw : ∀ i,(W i).extent=Peak.route A b k p c.Q D.p.B i.1)
    (hp : ∀ i,(W i).fires=sectionAt i)
    (hU : ∀ i U, Healthy D.p.threshold (Peak.route A b k p c.Q D.p.B i.1) U →
      ‖(W i).value U+C i‖ ≤ bill (-31/32) (A.clock.hatBeta k))
    (hV : ∀ i, ‖C i‖ ≤ bill (1/4) (A.clock.hatBeta k)) : Wells (Meter A ho u) W C (Peak.route A b k p c.Q D.p.B) := by
  let e := c.e; let s := A.clock.hatBeta k; let g := c.Q; let Y := Meter A ho u
  have he (i : Site (A.S.side (width A b k) p) × flame (Fin v)) {e : ℝ} (he : 0≤e) : charge D.p e (Peak.route A b k p g D.p.B i.1) * Poly.toll (fun _ => Y.radius) (sectionAt i) ≤
      Real.exp (e*((g+g+1:ℕ):ℝ)^4)*bill (1/8) s := mul_le_mul (charged_cube g he _) (aperture _ ho u i (by simpa using hv))
        (Poly.worth (fun _ => Y.pos_r) _).le (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hz (e : ℝ) : 0 ≤ Real.exp (e*((g+g+1:ℕ):ℝ)^4)*bill (1/8) s := mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.exp_pos _).le
  refine ⟨hp,hw, fun i U hh => (mul_le_mul (he i Y.base) (hU i U hh) (norm_nonneg _) (hz _)).trans u.wakes, ?_⟩
  intro i; exact (mul_le_mul (he i (add_nonneg Y.base zero_le_one)) (hV i) (norm_nonneg _) (hz _)).trans u.tree

theorem rebate (O : HaarBudget G) (hc : Allocated C.path.levels M k O b) (hb : bank O C.path.levels (width C.path.levels b k))
    {P : Rep G (C.side (width C.path.levels b k) p)} {u : Course C N p k} {hN : k ≤ N} {q : width C.path.levels b k ≤ N}
    (hp : Settled P u q) (t : Fin n → C.book.Token)
    (B : Fin n → (standard C).Tag) (hx : Fit C.path.levels b k x) (hn : n ≤ M)
    {e c d : ℝ} (he : 0 ≤ e) (hE : c≤1) (hC : d ≤ 1) (hv : estimate P u hN x (invoice B t hx N p) e c d (allowance C.path.levels M k))
    (s : modes (Fin n)) (sh : s.val.Nonempty) :
    let T := yard C b hN p
    T.rootTest (C.beta N p) (fun U => (invoice B t hx N p U).part s) ≤ budget C.path.levels M k := by
  intro T
  let A:= C.path.levels; let r:= width A b k
  obtain ⟨H,σ,g,Λ,δ,w,hD,hd⟩ := hp
  have hea := Array.postage (X:=invoice B t hx N p) (T:=T) u q O H hd hD.positive hD.entrance hD.assigned rfl (Real.exp_pos _) he (bill_cont _ _ hx N p) hv s
  have hc1 := hc.permitted.plateau r le_rfl ((wider A b k).trans (before A b k))
  have hQ : A.params r=A.params k := congr_arg A.clock.stage hc1
  let Z := Fintype.card (Site (A.S.side r p))
  rw [Fintype.card_fin, show Fintype.card T.Cell=Z from rfl] at hea
  have hs : d+n*c ≤ 1+(M:ℝ) := by
    refine add_le_add hC ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE (Nat.cast_nonneg _ : 0 ≤ (n:ℝ))).trans ?_)
    rw [mul_one]; exact_mod_cast hn
  let I := pot A M k
  have hi : protection O P (A.params r).paths Λ δ (d+n*c) g - 4*G.lieDim*Real.log g/(Z:ℝ) ≤ I := by
    apply (hb p P g Λ δ (d+n*c) M hD hs).trans
    change ticket O (A.params r) M ≤ I; rw [hQ]; exact hc.charge
  apply hea.trans
  let a := allowance A M k
  have ha : 1 ≤ a := fixed ..
  calc
    _ ≤ Real.exp I / a^s.val.card := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hi) (pow_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans ha) _)
    _ ≤ Real.exp I / a := by

        _ ≤ _ := pow_le_pow_right₀ ha (Finset.card_pos.mpr sh)
    _ = _ := by change Real.exp I / Real.exp (2*I)=Real.exp (-I); rw [← Real.exp_sub]; congr 1; ring

lemma off_label (B A : Weight L) (H : S.Hierarchy) (a b l d : Axis) (h : d≠a)
    (k : Axis) (f : Bool) (hf : Own B k f) (hh : Own A k (spar d b k)) (hp : f≠spar a b k) (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ q, readsCluster S B A q * positionTest (tracks (chart a b l) d n (canvas (shiftPlot d (orchard a)))) q)=0 := by
  let z (q : E4) := readsCluster S B A q * positionTest (tracks (chart a b l) d n (canvas (shiftPlot d (orchard a)))) q
  let K := Ortho.motion (Signed.reflect k)
  have hm (q : E4) : z (K q)= -z q := by
    have hu : signValue f*signValue (spar d b k)*signValue (spar a d k)=-1 := by
      have he (x y z f : Bool) (hp : f≠ Bool.xor x y) : signValue f*signValue (Bool.xor z y)*signValue (Bool.xor x z)=-1 := by
        cases x <;> cases y <;> cases z <;> cases f <;> simp_all [signValue]
      exact he _ _ _ _ hp
    unfold z; rw [show K q=Ortho.move _ q from rfl,reads_mirror S H.spin k B A f _ hf hh,pose_sign a b l d k h]
    simp only [← mul_assoc] at *; rw [mul_right_comm _ (readsCluster _ _ _ q),hu]; simp
  have ht : (∫ q,z q)= -(∫ q, z q) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← K.measurePreserving.integral_comp K.toHomeomorph.measurableEmbedding]
    simp_rw [hm,integral_neg]
  have hp : 2*(∫ q,z q)=0 := by

    exact neg_add_cancel _
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hp).resolve_left (by norm_num)

theorem answer : YM.Bid.A02 := by
  intro G L S h W hd _ J p Y hw
  -- Test the field identities first with all exterior words. No need here to
  -- use inclusion properties to change caps.
  constructor
  · intro d b v u
    apply S.field_ext h.laws.toSymmetric
    intro n q x hx
    obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ := exists_window hx
    have hh : (fun t => shellSpin S J χ v (Ward.cast x 0 b t) q u) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
        fun t => S.useAt S (Ward.cast x 0 b t) (Fin.cons ⟨d, Y d v u⟩ q) := by
      filter_upwards [stable hx hχ b] with t ht
      exact hw.raw.rotation ht.1 q ht.2 v d u
    have he := (deriv_head h hd hx b (Y d v u) q).unique
      (hh.hasDerivAt_iff.mp (deriv_shellSpin h hd hx hχ b J v u q))
    let T : Fin (n+1) → S.Tag := Fin.cons ⟨d, u⟩ q
    have hf (w : S.Field (d+1)) : S.useAt S x (Fin.cons ⟨d+1, w⟩ q) =
        Ward.here T x 0 (d+1) w := by
      rw [Ward.takes, show T = Fin.cons _ q from rfl, Fin.update_cons_zero]
      rfl
    rw [hf, map_add, map_sum]
    simp_rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, ← hf]
    rw [he, hw.raw.rotation hx q hχ v (d+1)]
    simp_rw [hw.raw.translation hx q hχ]
    rw [sub_add_cancel]
  · intro d b i u
    apply S.field_ext h.laws.toSymmetric
    intro n q x hx
    obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ := exists_window hx
    have hh : (fun t => shellGrad S J χ i (Ward.cast x 0 b t) q u) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
        fun t => S.useAt S (Ward.cast x 0 b t) (Fin.cons ⟨d+1, p d i u⟩ q) := by
      filter_upwards [stable hx hχ b] with t ht
      exact hw.raw.translation ht.1 q ht.2 i d u
    have he := (deriv_head h hd hx b (p d i u) q).unique
      (hh.hasDerivAt_iff.mp (deriv_shellGrad h hd hx hχ b i J u q))
    exact he.trans (hw.raw.translation hx q hχ i (d+1) (W.deriv d b u))

lemma deriv_shellSpin {x : Points (n+1)} (hx : x ∈ conf _) (hw : Window x χ) (b : Axis)
    (J : S.Stress) (v : Ortho.Skew) {d : ℕ} (B : S.Field d) (q : Fin n → S.Tag) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => shellSpin S J χ v (Ward.cast x 0 b t) q B)
      (shellSpin S J χ v x q (W.deriv d b B) -
        ∑ c : Axis, (v.val c b : ℂ) * shellGrad S J χ c x q B) 0 := by
  let F (a c : Axis) (t : ℝ) := ∫ y : E4,
    ((Analysis.D (basis a) χ y * M4.move v.val (y - Ward.cast x 0 b t 0) c : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      S.useAt S (Points.cons y (Ward.cast x 0 b t)) (Fin.cons ⟨4, J a c⟩ (Fin.cons ⟨d, B⟩ q))
  let A (a c : Axis) := ∫ y : E4,
    ((Analysis.D (basis a) χ y * M4.move v.val (y - x 0) c : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      S.useAt S (Points.cons y x) (Fin.cons ⟨4, J a c⟩ (Fin.cons ⟨d+1, W.deriv d b B⟩ q))
  let L' (a c : Axis) := ∫ y : E4,
    ((Analysis.D (basis a) χ y : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      S.useAt S (Points.cons y x) (Fin.cons ⟨4, J a c⟩ (Fin.cons ⟨d, B⟩ q))
  have row (a c : Axis) : HasDerivAt (F a c) ((-(v.val c b : ℂ)) * L' a c + A a c) 0 := by
    let m (z : ℝ × E4) : ℂ := ↑(M4.move v.val (z.2 - Ward.cast x 0 b z.1 0) c)
    have cm : Continuous m := by
      unfold m
      simp_rw [center_eq]
      have ht : Continuous (Ward.cast x 0 b) := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
        (fun t => (Ward.moves x 0 b t).continuousAt)
      have hc : Continuous (fun y : E4 => M4.move v.val y c) := by
        simp_rw [M4.at_coord]; fun_prop
      exact Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
        ((hc.comp continuous_snd).sub ((Ward.factor 0 c v).continuous.comp (ht.comp continuous_fst)))
    have hd' : ∀ (t : ℝ) (y : E4), HasDerivAt (fun s => m (s, y)) (-(v.val c b : ℂ)) t := by
      intro t y
      simpa only [m, Complex.ofReal_neg] using (deriv_center x v c b y t).ofReal_comp
    have he := deriv_integral h hd hx hw a b ⟨4, J a c⟩ d B q m (fun _ => -(v.val c b : ℂ))
      cm continuous_const hd'
    simp only [F, L', A, Complex.ofReal_mul]
    simp only [m, Ward.start] at he
    apply he.congr_deriv
    congr 1
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_congr_ae; filter_upwards with y; ring
  have he := HasDerivAt.fun_sum (u := (Finset.univ : Finset Axis))
    (fun a _ => HasDerivAt.fun_sum (u := (Finset.univ : Finset Axis)) (fun c _ => row a c))
  -- Both shells carry the leading minus sign. Regroup the terms from
  -- differentiating the centering as minus the matrix entries times the translation shells.
  apply (he.neg).congr_deriv
  change -(∑ a : Axis, ∑ c : Axis, (-(v.val c b : ℂ) * L' a c + A a c)) =
    -(∑ a : Axis, ∑ c : Axis, A a c) - ∑ c : Axis, (v.val c b : ℂ) * -(∑ a : Axis, L' a c)
  simp_rw [neg_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, mul_neg, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm (f := fun a c : Axis => (v.val c b : ℂ) * L' a c)]
  rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  abel
ends.conclusion: `deriv_shellSpin` differentiates the spin shell integral `shellSpin` along the motion of the first point.

    rw [ht, ← hp.raw.rotation hx q hχ u, ← hp.raw.rotation hx _ hχ u,
      ← flux_spin, ← flux_spin, flux_real h.laws.toSymmetric h.spin J hp.tensor.real hx hχ]
  · intro d e w u v
    apply S.field_ext h.laws.toSymmetric
    intro n q x hx
    obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ := exists_window x hx
    rw [hr.kernels w _ hx, ← hp.raw.rotation hx q hχ u e, ← hp.raw.rotation hx q hχ u d,

  · intro d u

    rw [← front_eval q x _ 0, map_zero, ← hp.raw.rotation hx q hχ u, ← flux_spin]
    exact flux_unit h.laws h.smooth W hd J hp.tensor (orbital u (x 0)) (smooth_orbital _ _)
      (killing_orbital _ _) hx q χ hχ d
  · intro d k u v
    apply ext_against_mirror h.laws.toSymmetric h.spin k

      (orbital u (x 0)) (orbital (Org.orients k u) (Ortho.move k.ortho (x 0))) (move_rotation k u (x 0)) q v).symm

    have hw := hp.raw.translation (Points.move_in k.ortho hx) (mirrorTag h.spin k ∘ q)
