lemma stagger (x : Points m) (hx : x∈conf _) (p : Parts S) (Y : SpinRows S) (q : Fin m→ S.Tag) (H : S.Hierarchy) (a b : Axis) (h : a≠b) :
    localTurn p Y (Ortho.plane b a) q (Points.across (basis a) x) = localTurn p Y (Ortho.plane b a) q x +
      ∑ i, disc (update q i (⟨_,p _ b (q i).2⟩:S.Tag)) x := by
  let K := Ortho.plane b a; let y := Points.across (basis a) x
  have he (r : Fin m→S.Tag) : disc r y=disc r x := H.translations m x hx _ (expose ∘ r)
  have hf (i : Fin m) (j : Axis) : M4.move K.val (y i) j = M4.move K.val (x i) j + basis b j := by
    have h : roll K (basis a) j=basis b j := by
      rw [show K= _ from rfl,roll_plane]; by_cases hv : j=b <;> simp [hv,Ne.symm h]
    rw [← h]; exact congr_arg (fun y : E4 => y j) (map_add (Matrix.toEuclideanLin K.val) (x i) (basis a))
  change localTurn p Y K q y=_; unfold localTurn; simp_rw [he,hf,add_smul,Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp [add_assoc,K]

private lemma full_jet (h : S.Hierarchy) (W : DiffPlan S)
    (inc : W.Inclusions S) (der : W.Derivatives S)
    (p : Parts S) (c : ColorLaw p W h.spin)
    (delta : ∀ d b i u, W.deriv (d+1) b (p d i u) = p (d+1) i (W.deriv d b u))
    (hl : LineSum p)
    (b j : Axis) (hj : j ≠ b)
    {x : Points n} (hx : x ∈ conf _) (ht : onLine b x)
    (q : Fin n → S.Tag) (m : ℕ) (u : Fin m → Points n) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (row p j q) x u = 0 := by
  induction m generalizing q with
  | zero =>
    simpa using all_line h W inc p c hl b j hj q hx ht
  | succ m ih =>
    have hr : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (row p j q) x := by
      apply ContDiffAt.sum
      exact fun i _ => cont_disc h _ hx
    have hh : ContDiffAt ℝ (↑(m+1 : ℕ)) (row p j q) x :=
      hr.of_le (show ((↑(m+1 : ℕ)) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ from WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
    let v := Fin.init u
    let g : Points n →L[ℝ] ℂ := (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m+1) (row p j q) x).curryRight v
    have hb (k : Fin n) (a : Axis) : g (Points.direction k a) = 0 := by
      change iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m+1) (row p j q) x (Fin.snoc v (Points.direction k a)) = 0
      have hp :
          D (Points.direction k a) (row p j q) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] row p j (update q k (rise W a (q k))) := by
        filter_upwards [(conf_open _).mem_nhds hx] with y hy
        exact row_D h W der p delta j q hy k a
      rw [snoc_jet hh, (hp.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
      exact ih _ _
    have ha (w : Points n) : g w = 0 := by
      rw [← expand_pts w, map_sum]
      simp [map_sum,hb]
    have hy := ha (u (Fin.last m))
    change iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m+1) (row p j q) x
      (Fin.snoc (Fin.init u) (u (Fin.last m))) = 0 at hy
    rwa [Fin.snoc_init_self] at hy
ends.conclusion: `full_jet` shows by induction on `m`, using `delta`, that every positional jet of the line sum vanishes on the line.

private lemma line_native (h : S.Hierarchy) (W : DiffPlan S) (der : W.Derivatives S) :
    LineSum W.deriv := by
  intro d n b j hj v x hx ht
  let q := column v
  let u := points fun _ : Fin n => basis j
  have hu : (∑ i : Fin n, Points.direction i j) = u := by
    simpa [u] using expand_pts u
  let F (t : ℝ) := x+t • u
  have hr : F 0 = x := by simp [F]
  have hh : HasDerivAt F u 0 := by
    have he := (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ u).hasDerivAt (x := 0)
    simpa [F] using he.const_add x
  have he : (disc q ∘ F) = fun (_ : ℝ) => disc q x := by
    funext t
    exact h.translations n x hx (t • basis j) (fun i => ⟨(q i).1,S.representative _ (q i).2⟩)
  have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (disc q) (F 0) := by
    rw [hr]
    exact (cont_disc h q hx).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hz : fderiv ℝ (disc q) x u = 0 := by
    have hp := hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 hh
    rw [he,hr] at hp
    exact hp.unique (hasDerivAt_const _ _)
  change row W.deriv j q x = 0
  rw [← hz, ← hu, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  exact (fromD W h der hx i j q).symm
ends.conclusion: `line_native` gives `LineSum W.deriv` by translation invariance, the same identities for `∂`.

lemma fixed_kernel (P : Select L d) {V : Scaling S} {h a} (Z : Subs P V)
    (W : DiffPlan S) (K : DiffPlan (Bel L)) (hx : V.Align W K h a (d+1)) (H : Ens P K a) (X Y : Parts S)

    (hw : ∀ᶠ i in atTop, Z.moves i (V.aisle i d (leaves X d))=0 ∧ Z.moves i (V.aisle i d (leaves Y d))=0) :

lemma extends_form (W : DiffPlan S) (K : DiffPlan (Bel L)) (H : S.Hierarchy) {a} (P : Parts S) (hw : W.Inclusions S) (hv : ColorLaw W.deriv W H.spin) (he : ColorLaw P W H.spin)

    obtain ⟨⟨V,Y,Z,H1,H2,H3,H4⟩,H5,H6⟩ := hD d h
    obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := fixed_kernel Y Z _ _ H1 H2 _ _ hv he H5 H3 H4
    exact ⟨c,fun e => H6 (hc.trans (by subst c; ext j k; simp)),hc⟩
  obtain ⟨c,hc,Ht⟩ := hh D le_rfl
  refine ⟨c,hc,fun d => ?_⟩
  rcases le_total D d with h|h
  · obtain ⟨p,ht,hp⟩ := hh d h
    have he' : p=c := (smul_left_injective ℝ (hD D le_rfl).2.1) ((over_peak W H hw hv he h p hp).symm.trans Ht)
    exact he' ▸ hp

lemma over_peak (W : DiffPlan S) (h : S.Hierarchy) (hp : W.Inclusions S) {X Y : Parts S} (hx : ColorLaw X W h.spin)
    (hy : ColorLaw Y W h.spin) {d D} (hw : d ≤ D) (c : ℝ) (he : leaves Y D=c • leaves X D) : leaves Y d=c • leaves X d := by
  ext1 i; ext1 u
  apply W.inject h.laws.toSymmetric hp (Nat.succ_le_succ hw)
  have hL := congr_arg (fun g : Vector D S => g i (W.rise hw u)) he
  change Y D i (W.rise hw u)=c • X D i (W.rise hw u) at hL
  rw [hx.incl _ D hw,hy.incl _ D hw] at hL
  change _= W.rise _ (c • X d i u)
  have ht := (W.rise (Nat.succ_le_succ hw)).restrictScalars ℝ |>.map_smul c (X d i u)
  exact hL.trans ht.symm

theorem traverses (h : S.Hierarchy) (he : W.Derivatives S) (hc : commutes W T)
    {x : Points n} (hx : x∈conf _) (q : Fin n → S.Tag) (a : Axis) (k : Fin n) (K : Ortho.Skew) :
    let r := update q k (rise W a (q k))
    D (Points.direction k a) (angular W T q K) x= angular W T r K x := by
  intro r
  let t := Points.direction k a
  let comp (i) := disc (update q i (turns T K (q i)))
  let L (i) (b : Axis) := disc (update q i (rise W b (q i)))
  let y (i) (b) (z : Points n) := factor i b K z • L i b z
  let f (i) z := comp i z + ∑ b, y i b z
  have hu (i : Fin n) b : DifferentiableAt ℝ (L i b) x := (cont_disc h _ hx).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hh i b : DifferentiableAt ℝ (y i b) x := (factor i b K).differentiableAt.smul (hu i b)
  have hz i : DifferentiableAt ℝ (comp i) x := (cont_disc h _ hx).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hp i : DifferentiableAt ℝ (f i) x := (hz i).add (DifferentiableAt.fun_sum fun b hb => hh i b)
  have hm (i : Fin n) : D t (f i) x=D t (comp i) x+∑ b, D t (y i b) x := by
    simp only [f,D,fderiv_fun_add (hz i) (DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun b hb => hh i b)),
      fderiv_fun_sum (fun b hb => hh i b),_root_.sum_apply, _root_.add_apply]
  change fderiv ℝ (fun z => ∑ i, f i z) x t= _
  rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun i hi => hp i),_root_.sum_apply]; unfold angular
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i hi
  change D t (f i) x=_; rw [hm]
  by_cases hv : i=k
  · subst i; simp only [r,update_self,update_idem]
    -- derivative comm produces orbital cancel
    have hvb b : D t (y k b) x=(K.val b a) • disc (update q k (rise W b (q k))) x + factor k b K x • disc
        (update q k (rise W b (rise W a (q k)))) x := by
      unfold y
      rw [D_prod _ _ _ x (hu k b)]
      dsimp only [t,L]
      rw [fac,if_pos rfl,fromD W h he hx,update_self, update_idem]; unfold rise
      simp only
      rw [W.abelian h.laws.toSymmetric he h.smooth]
    simp_rw [hvb,Finset.sum_add_distrib,← add_assoc]
    congr 1
    unfold comp; rw [fromD W h he hx,update_self,update_idem]; unfold turns rise; simp only
    simp_rw [← takes,Complex.real_smul]
    rw [← hc _,map_add,map_sum]; simp
  have hu' : r i=q i := update_of_ne hv ..
  rw [hu']; congr 1
  · unfold comp; rw [fromD W h he hx,update_of_ne (Ne.symm hv),update_comm (show k≠i from (Ne.symm hv))] -- order check
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro b hb
  unfold y
  rw [D_prod _ _ _ x (hu i b)]
  dsimp only [L,t]; rw [fac,if_neg (Ne.symm hv),zero_smul,zero_add,fromD W h he hx,update_of_ne (Ne.symm hv),update_comm (show k≠i from (Ne.symm hv))]
  rfl
ends.conclusion: `traverses` shows the derivative of `angular W T q K` in direction `(k, a)` is the angular sum with the label `q k` replaced by `rise W a (q k)`, using the commutator `commutes`.

lemma jet_line (h : S.Hierarchy) (g : W.Derivatives S) (hc : commutes W T) (K : Ortho.Skew) (q : Fin n → S.Tag)
    (x : Points n) (i b s) (ht : cast x i b s ∈ conf _) (hp : ∀ w, angular W T w K (cast x i b s)=0) (m : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv m (angular W T q K ∘ cast x i b) s=0 := by
  induction m generalizing q with
  | zero => simp [hp]
  | succ m ih =>
    have hx := (conf_open _).mem_nhds ht
    have hu : deriv (angular W T q K ∘ cast x i b) =ᶠ[𝓝 s] angular W T (update q i (rise W b (q i))) K ∘ cast x i b :=
      Eventually.mono (p := fun j => cast x i b j ∈ conf n) ((moves _ _ _ s).continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds hx)
        fun k hk => (arrow W T h g hc K q _ _ _ _ hk).deriv
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hu.iteratedDeriv_eq (n := m)]
    exact ih _
ends.conclusion: `jet_line` shows that if all angular sums vanish at a point of a motion `cast x i b`, every iterated derivative of `angular W T q K ∘ cast x i b` vanishes there.

lemma htQ (K) (p : S.Tag × S.Tag) : AnalyticOnNhd ℝ (Q T K a p) PDE.side := by
  obtain ⟨⟨d,u⟩,⟨e,v⟩⟩ := p
  intro x hx
  change AnalyticAt ℝ (fun x => E (clock T u K (-Circle.θ x)) (clock T v K (-Circle.θ x)) (Circle.r x • basis a)) x
  simp_rw [stars (sector d) (sector e) (clock T u K _) (clock T v K _)]
  -- need selectively
  apply ContDiffAt.analyticAt; refine ContDiffAt.sum (fun i hi => ?_)
  apply ContDiffAt.sum; intro j hj
  let A : S.Field d →L[ℝ] ℂ := (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap ((sector (S := S) d).coord i)).restrictScalars ℝ
  let B : S.Field e →L[ℝ] ℂ := (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap ((sector (S := S) e).coord j)).restrictScalars ℝ
  obtain ⟨hθ,hr⟩ := Circle.uniform hx
  exact ((((A.analyticAt _).comp ((atClock T u K _).comp hθ.neg)).mul
    ((B.analyticAt _).comp ((atClock T v K _).comp hθ.neg))).mul
    ((radial V h ⟨d,sector (S := S) d i⟩ ⟨e,sector (S := S) e j⟩ (Circle.r x) (Circle.pos hx)).comp hr)).contDiffAt
ends.conclusion: `htQ` proves `Q` analytic on the half plane `side`, through the matrix coefficient `radial`.

lemma solves (K) (p : S.Tag × S.Tag) (x : PDE.V) (hx : x∈PDE.side) : PDE.law (left K T) (right K T) (Q T K a) p x=0 := by
  let H := htQ V h T K p
  have hv := Circle.transport ((H x hx).differentiableAt)
  suffices he : HasDerivAt (fun t => Q T K a p (Circle.shift x t))
      (-Q T K a (left K T p) x+-Q T K a (right K T p) x) 0 by
    unfold PDE.law; rw [PDE.vector (show PDE.C (Q T K a p) from fun x hx => (H x hx).contDiffAt) hx, ← Circle.u, hv.unique he]; ring
  clear H hv
  obtain ⟨⟨d,v⟩,⟨e,u⟩⟩ := p
  obtain ⟨hθ,hρ⟩ := Circle.vector hx
  let f (t : ℝ) := Circle.θ (Circle.shift x t)
  let Z (t : ℝ) := -f t
  let r (t : ℝ) := Circle.r (Circle.shift x t)
  have hr : 0 < r 0 := by unfold r;rw [Circle.gone]; exact Circle.pos hx
  let V' := T d K v
  let U' := T e K u
  let X (i) : S.Field d →L[ℝ] ℂ := (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap ((sector (S := S) d).coord i)).restrictScalars ℝ
  let Y (i) : S.Field e →L[ℝ] ℂ := (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap ((sector (S := S) e).coord i)).restrictScalars ℝ
  have hy : Z 0= -Circle.θ x := by simp [Z,f]
  have hl : r 0= Circle.r x := by simp [r]
  change HasDerivAt (fun t => E (clock T v K (Z t)) (clock T u K (Z t)) (r t • basis a))
    (- E (clock T V' K (-Circle.θ x)) (clock T u K (-Circle.θ x)) (Circle.r x • basis a)+
       - E (clock T v K (-Circle.θ x)) (clock T U' K (-Circle.θ x)) (Circle.r x • basis a)) 0
  rw [← hy,← hl]
  simp_rw [stars (sector d) (sector e) (clock T _ K _)]
  simp_rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib,← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply HasDerivAt.fun_sum; intro i hi; apply HasDerivAt.fun_sum; intro j hj
  have he : HasDerivAt Z (-1) 0 := hθ.neg
  have hw : HasDerivAt (fun t => r t) 0 0 := hρ
  have hh (c : ℕ) (v : S.Field c) : HasDerivAt (fun t => clock T v K (Z t)) (-clock T (T c K v) K (Z 0)) 0 := by
    have hh := (moveClock T v K (Z 0)).scomp 0 he
    simpa only [neg_smul,one_smul,Function.comp_def] using hh
  have hV : HasDerivAt (fun t => X i (clock T v K (Z t))) (- X i (clock T V' K (Z 0))) 0 := by
    have hv := (X i).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 (hh d v)
    simpa only [map_neg, Function.comp_def] using hv
  have hU : HasDerivAt (fun t => Y j (clock T u K (Z t))) (- Y j (clock T U' K (Z 0))) 0 := by
    have hv := (Y j).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 (hh e u)
    simpa only [map_neg,Function.comp_def] using hv
  let g (q : ℝ) := E (sector (S := S) d i) (sector (S := S) e j) (q • basis a)
  have hg : HasDerivAt (g ∘ r) 0 0 := by
    have hA : AnalyticAt ℝ g (r 0) := radial V h ⟨d,_⟩ ⟨e,_⟩ _ hr
    simpa only [zero_smul] using hA.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt.scomp 0 hw
  change HasDerivAt (fun t => (X i (clock T v K (Z t))*Y j (clock T u K (Z t)))*g (r t))
    (-(X i (clock T V' K (Z 0))*Y j (clock T u K (Z 0))*g (r 0))+ -(X i (clock T v K (Z 0))* Y j (clock T U' K (Z 0))*g (r 0))) 0
  convert (hV.mul hU).mul hg using 1 <;> try rfl
  dsimp only [Pi.mul_apply,Function.comp_apply];ring
ends.conclusion: `solves` shows `Q` satisfies the angular equation `PDE.law (left K T) (right K T) (Q T K a) p x = 0`.

theorem realized (h : b≠a) (W : DiffPlan S) (T : SpinRows S) (H : S.Hierarchy) (g : W.Derivatives S)
    (C : commutes W T) (Y : Collinear W T)
    (p : S.Tag × S.Tag) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0<t) :
    let K := Ortho.plane b a
    PDE.tower (PDE.law (left K T) (right K T) (F a b) p) n (t,0)=0 := by
  intro K
  rw [← PDE.actual (f := PDE.law _ _ _ p) (PDE.regular (left K T) (right K T) (fun i => Fu a b H i h) p)
    (x := (t,0)) (show _ from ht) n]; dsimp only
  let z := put a b (t,0)
  have hz y : put a b (t,y)=cast z 0 b y := by
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [put,lift,z,cast,Points.direction]
  rw [show (fun y => PDE.law _ _ _ p (t,y))= angular W T ![p.1,p.2] K ∘ cast z 0 b from
      funext (fun y => (sigma a b h W T H g p (x := (t,y)) (show _ from ht)).trans (by rw [hz];rfl))]
  have hv : cast z 0 b 0 ∈ conf _ := by rw [start]; exact ranges a b ht h
  refine jet_line W T H g C K _ z 0 b 0 hv (fun w => Y a _ _ _ _ hv ?_) n
  rw [start]; intro i; fin_cases i
  · exact ⟨t,by simp [z,put,lift]⟩
  exact ⟨0,by simp [z,put,lift]⟩
ends.conclusion: `realized` shows all jets of the angular law of `F` vanish on the axis, from `Collinear` and `jet_line`.

lemma flow_step {f} (hf : C f) (n : ℕ) {x} (h : x∈side) :
    tower (tangent f) (n+1) x = tangent (tower f (n+1)) x-(n+1) • D e (tower f n) x := by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => rw [tower_step,tower_step f,root,root]; simpa using flow_one hf h
  | succ n hn =>
    rw [tower_step (tangent _),GermD i (eventuallyEq_of_mem (g := fun t => tangent (tower f (n+1)) t-(n+1) • D e (tower f n) t) (opens.mem_nhds h) (fun x h => hn h)),
      D_sub (hf.limbs (n+1)).tangentC (show C (fun x => (n+1) • D e (tower f n) x) from fun t ht => by
        simp_rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ]; exact contDiffAt_const.smul ((hf.limbs n).incl _ _ ht)) h]
    rw [flow_one (hf.limbs _) h]
    have hw : D i (fun y => (n+1) • D e (tower f n) y) x=(n+1) • D i (D e (tower f n)) x := by
      simp_rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℝ]
      rw [D, fderiv_fun_const_smul ((hf.limbs n).incl e |>.able h)]; rfl
    rw [hw,(hf.limbs _).swaps i e h,← tower_step f n, tower_step f (n+1),add_smul];simp;ring
ends.conclusion: `flow_step` gives `tower (tangent f) (n+1) x = tangent (tower f (n+1)) x - (n+1) • D e (tower f n) x`, the `t ∂_s^{m+1} - m ∂_t ∂_s^{m-1}` form of the angular term.

theorem sure {F} (hc : ∀ j : I, C (F j))
    (h : ∀ j n t, 0<t → tower (law l r F j) n (t,0)=0)
    (hh : ∀ j t, 0<t → F j (t,0)=0) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0<t) (j : I) :
    tower (F j) n (t,0)=0 := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing t j with
  | h n ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero => exact hh j t ht
    | succ n =>
      let x := (t,(0:ℝ))
      have he : tower (law l r F j) n x=tower (F (l j)) n x+tower (F (r j)) n x+tower (tangent (F j)) n x := by
        unfold law; rw [addJet ((hc _).add (hc _)) (hc j).tangentC n (show x ∈ side from ht)]; dsimp only; rw [addJet (hc _) (hc _) n (show x∈side from ht)]
      have hv : tangent (tower (F j) n) x=t • tower (F j) (n+1) x := by simp [tangent,x,tower_step]
      have hy := h j n t ht
      change tower (law l r F j) n x=0 at hy
      rw [he, ih n n.lt_succ_self _ ht, ih n n.lt_succ_self _ ht,zero_add,zero_add] at hy
      cases n with
      | zero => exact (smul_eq_zero_iff_right ht.ne').mp (hv.symm.trans hy)
      | succ n =>
        rw [flow_step (hc j) n (show x∈side from ht), lean (hc j) n (fun t h => ih n (by omega) _ h _) t ht,smul_zero,sub_zero,hv] at hy
        exact (smul_eq_zero_iff_right ht.ne').mp hy
ends.conclusion: `sure` shows by strong induction on the order, for all labels `j` at once, that `tower (F j) n (t, 0) = 0` for every `n`.

theorem blossoms (h : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (A a : ℝ → ℂ) (ha : AnalyticAt ℝ a 0)
    (hv : ∀ x t, inner ℂ (f x) (f t)=A (t-x)) (ht : ∀ n, iteratedDeriv n A 0=iteratedDeriv n a 0)
    (x : ℝ) : AnalyticAt ℝ f x := by
  obtain ⟨C,hc,ρ,r,Hb⟩ := center a 0 ha
  apply builds f h (√C) (ρ/2) (by positivity) (by positivity) _ x
  intro m x
  unfold Power at *
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).1
  have he : ‖iteratedDeriv m f x‖^2 ≤ C*(ρ^(m+m))⁻¹*((m+m).factorial:ℝ) := by
    have he := congr_arg norm (bud f h x x A hv m m)
    simp [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K,ht] at he
    rw [he]; exact Hb _
  apply he.trans
  have Hh : (m+m).factorial ≤ 2^(m+m)*m.factorial^2 := by
    calc _ = (m+m).choose m * m.factorial * m.factorial := by rw [← Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial (show m≤m+m by omega),Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
         _ ≤ _ := by rw [pow_two,← mul_assoc];gcongr; exact Nat.choose_le_two_pow ..
  calc _ ≤ C * (ρ^(m+m))⁻¹ * (2^(m+m)*(m.factorial:ℝ)^2) := by gcongr; exact_mod_cast Hh
       _ = _ := by
        rw [mul_pow, mul_pow (√C),Real.sq_sqrt hc.le]
        simp only [pow_add,div_pow, inv_div] -- simplified?
        field_simp
ends.conclusion: `blossoms` bounds `‖iteratedDeriv m f x‖^2` by the Gram kernel's Cauchy estimate `C ρ^{-2m} (2m)! ≤ C (2/ρ)^{2m} (m!)^2` and concludes `f` analytic.

theorem builds (h : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (C ρ : ℝ) (hC : 0<C) (hr : 0<ρ)
    (hh : ∀ n x, ‖iteratedDeriv n f x‖ ≤ Power C ρ n) (x : ℝ) : AnalyticAt ℝ f x := by
  let a := x-ρ/4
  have hx : x∈ Ioo a (a+ρ/2) := by constructor <;> dsimp only [a] <;> linarith
  let u : FormalMultilinearSeries ℝ ℝ E := fun n => Tensor.coeff f n a
  have he := groups f h C ρ hC hr hh a x hx
  have hu : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun y => u.sum (y-a)) x :=
    ((FormalMultilinearSeries.analyticOnNhd (p := u) _ he.1).comp (f := fun y => y-a)
      (analyticAt_id.sub analyticAt_const))
  exact hu.congr ( (show ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, y∈ Ioo a (a+ρ/2) from Ioo_mem_nhds hx.1 hx.2) |>.mono (fun i hi => (groups f h C ρ hC hr hh a i hi).2))
ends.conclusion: `builds` turns a bound `‖iteratedDeriv n f x‖ ≤ C ρ^{-n} n!` into analyticity by Taylor's remainder, uniformly in `x`.

lemma channel (P : W.Derivatives S) (Y : Collinear W T) (C : commutes W T) (x : Points n) (k b) (K : Ortho.Skew) (p : Fin n → S.Tag)
    (s : ℝ) (hv : Earliest (cast x k b s) a k ∨ Latest (cast x k b s) a k) : AnalyticAt ℝ (angular W T p K ∘ cast x k b) s := by
  let V := Classical.choice (realization H a)
  have ha (i : Fin n → S.Tag) : ContDiffAt ℝ ω (disc i ∘ cast x k b) s := AnalyticAt.contDiffAt
    (hv.elim (first_adv V H W T P Y C _ _ _ _ _) (last_adv V H W T P Y C _ _ _ _ _))
  apply ContDiffAt.analyticAt
  unfold Function.comp angular
  apply ContDiffAt.sum

theorem traverses (h : S.Hierarchy) (he : W.Derivatives S) (hc : commutes W T)
    {x : Points n} (hx : x∈conf _) (q : Fin n → S.Tag) (a : Axis) (k : Fin n) (K : Ortho.Skew) :
    let r := update q k (rise W a (q k))
    D (Points.direction k a) (angular W T q K) x= angular W T r K x := by
  intro r
  let t := Points.direction k a
  let comp (i) := disc (update q i (turns T K (q i)))
  let L (i) (b : Axis) := disc (update q i (rise W b (q i)))
  let y (i) (b) (z : Points n) := factor i b K z • L i b z
  let f (i) z := comp i z + ∑ b, y i b z
  have hu (i : Fin n) b : DifferentiableAt ℝ (L i b) x := (cont_disc h _ hx).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hh i b : DifferentiableAt ℝ (y i b) x := (factor i b K).differentiableAt.smul (hu i b)
  have hz i : DifferentiableAt ℝ (comp i) x := (cont_disc h _ hx).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hp i : DifferentiableAt ℝ (f i) x := (hz i).add (DifferentiableAt.fun_sum fun b hb => hh i b)
  have hm (i : Fin n) : D t (f i) x=D t (comp i) x+∑ b, D t (y i b) x := by
    simp only [f,D,fderiv_fun_add (hz i) (DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun b hb => hh i b)),
      fderiv_fun_sum (fun b hb => hh i b),_root_.sum_apply, _root_.add_apply]
  change fderiv ℝ (fun z => ∑ i, f i z) x t= _
  rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun i hi => hp i),_root_.sum_apply]; unfold angular
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i hi
  change D t (f i) x=_; rw [hm]
  by_cases hv : i=k
  · subst i; simp only [r,update_self,update_idem]
    -- derivative comm produces orbital cancel
    have hvb b : D t (y k b) x=(K.val b a) • disc (update q k (rise W b (q k))) x + factor k b K x • disc
        (update q k (rise W b (rise W a (q k)))) x := by
      unfold y
      rw [D_prod _ _ _ x (hu k b)]
      dsimp only [t,L]
      rw [fac,if_pos rfl,fromD W h he hx,update_self, update_idem]; unfold rise
      simp only
      rw [W.abelian h.laws.toSymmetric he h.smooth]
    simp_rw [hvb,Finset.sum_add_distrib,← add_assoc]
    congr 1
    unfold comp; rw [fromD W h he hx,update_self,update_idem]; unfold turns rise; simp only
    simp_rw [← takes,Complex.real_smul]
    rw [← hc _,map_add,map_sum]; simp
  have hu' : r i=q i := update_of_ne hv ..
  rw [hu']; congr 1
  · unfold comp; rw [fromD W h he hx,update_of_ne (Ne.symm hv),update_comm (show k≠i from (Ne.symm hv))] -- order check
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro b hb
  unfold y
  rw [D_prod _ _ _ x (hu i b)]
  dsimp only [L,t]; rw [fac,if_neg (Ne.symm hv),zero_smul,zero_add,fromD W h he hx,update_of_ne (Ne.symm hv),update_comm (show k≠i from (Ne.symm hv))]
  rfl
ends.conclusion: `traverses` shows every positional derivative of an angular sum is an angular sum with differentiated labels.

  have he : Tendsto z (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 x) := by
    have h : Continuous z := continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)

lemma pushes {x : Points n} {k : Fin n} (h : Earliest x a k) (w : b≠a) : ∃ y : Points n,
    Walk n x y ∧ (∀ i≠k, x i=y i) ∧ Latest y a k ∧ (∃ t : ℝ, y k=t • basis a) := by

  have hx : Latest u b k := by
    refine ⟨(still_first a b h w _).1,fun i h => ?_⟩
    simp [u,near _ _ _ h,hT i]
  obtain ⟨J,hJ⟩ := ta (fun i : Fin n => u i a)
  let v := cast u k a (J-u k a)
  have hv : Walk n u v := .bridge _ _ b a _ (fun i s => Or.inr (still_last b a hx w.symm i))
  have hz : Latest v a k := by
    refine ⟨(still_last b a hx w.symm _).1,fun i h => ?_⟩

lemma invariant_form (ρ : Ortho → Y →ₗ[ℝ] Y)
    (hc : ∀ x, Continuous fun g => ρ g x)
    (h1 : ∀ x, ρ 1 x = x)
    (hm : ∀ g k x, ρ (g*k) x = ρ g (ρ k x)) :
    ∃ B : Y →ₗ[ℝ] Y →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, (∀ x y, B x y = B y x) ∧
      (∀ x, x ≠ 0 → 0 < B x x) ∧ ∀ k x y, B (ρ k x) (ρ k y) = B x y := by
  classical
  letI : CompactSpace Ortho := compact_ortho
  letI : MeasurableSpace Ortho := borel _
  letI : BorelSpace Ortho := ⟨rfl⟩
  let b := Module.finBasis ℝ Y
  let u (x y : Y) (g : Ortho) : ℝ := ∑ i, b.coord i (ρ g⁻¹ x) * b.coord i (ρ g⁻¹ y)
  have ht (x y : Y) : Continuous (u x y) :=
    continuous_finsetSum _ (fun i _ =>
      ((b.coord i).continuous_of_finiteDimensional.comp ((hc x).comp continuous_inv)).mul
        ((b.coord i).continuous_of_finiteDimensional.comp ((hc y).comp continuous_inv)))
  have hu (x y : Y) : Integrable (u x y) Measure.haar :=
    (ht _ _).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  let B0 (x y : Y) := ∫ g, u x y g ∂Measure.haar
  have hs (x y : Y) : B0 x y = B0 y x := by
    unfold B0; simp_rw [u, mul_comm]
  have ha (x y z : Y) : B0 (x+y) z = B0 x z + B0 y z := by
    have h (g) : u (x+y) z g = u x z g + u y z g := by
      unfold u; simp_rw [map_add, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    unfold B0; simp_rw [h]; exact integral_add (hu _ _) (hu _ _)
  have hw (c : ℝ) (x y : Y) : B0 (c • x) y = c • B0 x y := by
    have h (g) : u (c • x) y g = c * u x y g := by
      unfold u; simp_rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum]
    unfold B0; simp_rw [h]; exact integral_const_mul ..
  let B1 (x : Y) : Y →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ := {
    toFun := B0 x
    map_add' := fun y z => by rw [hs, ha, hs y, hs z]
    map_smul' := fun c y => by rw [hs, hw, hs y]; rfl }
  let B : Y →ₗ[ℝ] Y →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ := {
    toFun := B1
    map_add' := fun x y => by ext1 z; exact ha ..
    map_smul' := fun c y => by ext1 z; exact hw .. }
  refine ⟨B, hs, fun x hx => ?_, fun k x y => ?_⟩
  · have hn (g : Ortho) : 0 ≤ u x x g := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg _)
    have hp : 0 < u x x 1 := by
      obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ : ∃ i, b.coord i x ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra! h
        apply hx; apply b.ext_elem; intro i; simpa using h i
      unfold u; rw [inv_one]; simp_rw [h1]
      exact Finset.sum_pos' (fun j _ => mul_self_nonneg _) ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, mul_self_pos.mpr hi⟩
    exact integral_pos_of_integrable_nonneg_nonzero (ht _ _) (hu _ _) hn hp.ne'
  have h (g : Ortho) : u (ρ k x) (ρ k y) g = u x y (k⁻¹*g) := by
    unfold u; simp only [← hm, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv]
  change (∫ g, u (ρ k x) (ρ k y) g ∂Measure.haar) = ∫ g, u x y g ∂Measure.haar
  simp_rw [h]; exact integral_mul_left_eq_self ..
ends.conclusion: The compact group `Ortho` carries an invariant positive form on `Mat X`.

lemma casimir (p : Ind) : Commute (∑ q : Ind, f (Spin.K q)^2) (f (Spin.K p)) := by
  obtain ⟨i,j⟩ := p
  let P (a b : Axis) := f (plane a b)
  let g (a b : Axis) := (if b=i then P a j else 0) - (if b=j then P a i else 0) +
    (if a=i then P j b else 0) - (if a=j then P i b else 0)
  have hg (a b : Axis) : P a b * P i j - P i j * P a b = g a b := by
    dsimp [P]; rw [h, bracket_planes]; simp [P, g, apply_ite f]
  have he (a b : Axis) : P a b^2 * P i j - P i j * P a b^2 = P a b * g a b + g a b * P a b := by
    rw [← hg]; noncomm_ring
  change (∑ q : Ind, P q.1 q.2 ^ 2) * P i j = P i j * (∑ q : Ind, P q.1 q.2 ^ 2)
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  dsimp only
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, he]
  simp [g, mul_add, add_mul, mul_sub, sub_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  abel
ends.conclusion: `casimir` shows the sum of squares of the relative generators commutes with each one, the antisymmetric structure constants cancelling in pairs.

    ∃ y : R, Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => φ^[n] x) atTop (𝓝 y) ∧ defect y=0 ∧ ‖y-x‖ ≤ C * (ε*2) := by

  have ht i : f (i+1)=φ (f i) := iterate_succ_apply' ..

  have hb (i : ℕ) (hi : ‖defect (f i)‖ ≤ s i) (hy : ‖f i-x‖ ≤ C*(ε-s i)*2) :

      calc ‖f i‖ ≤ ‖f i-x‖ + ‖x‖ := by nth_rw 1 [← sub_add_cancel (f i) x]; exact norm_add_le ..

               (sub_le_self _ (hs i)) hc.le) (by norm_num))) _
           _ ≤ A := by linarith
    rw [dist_eq_norm,ht,offset]; apply (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul (?_ : ‖1-2*f i‖ ≤ C) hi (norm_nonneg _) hc.le)
    apply (norm_sub_le ..).trans _
    linarith [le_trans (norm_mul_le (2:R) (f i)) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl (norm_nonneg (2:R)))]
  have hv i : ‖defect (f i)‖ ≤ s i ∧ ‖f i-x‖ ≤ C*(ε-s i)*2 := by
    induction i with

lemma stable {z : R} (hz : defect z=0) (Z : ℕ → R) (ht : Tendsto Z atTop (𝓝 z)) : ∃ P : ℕ → R,
    (∀ᶠ n in atTop, Tendsto (fun i : ℕ => φ^[i] (Z n)) atTop (𝓝 (P n)) ∧ defect (P n)=0) ∧ Tendsto P atTop (𝓝 z) := by
  let A := ‖z‖+1
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := exists_gt (‖(1:R)‖+‖(2:R)‖*A)
  have hc : 0 < C := by
    have hv : 0<A := by dsimp only [A]; positivity
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (by positivity) hC
  let E n := ‖defect (Z n)‖
  have he : Tendsto E atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hv := (ht.pow 2 |>.sub ht).norm
    rw [show z^2-z=0 from hz,norm_zero] at hv; exact hv
  have hh : Tendsto (fun i => C*(E i*2)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by simpa using ((he.mul_const (2:ℝ)).const_mul C)
  have hy : ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ‖Z i‖+C*(E i*2) ≤ A := by
    apply ((ht.norm.add hh).eventually (gt_mem_nhds (?_ : ‖z‖+0 < A))).mono (fun i hi => show _ from le_of_lt hi)
    dsimp only [A]; linarith
  have hp := (he.const_mul ‖(4:R)‖ |>.add_const ‖(3:R)‖ |>.mul he)
  simp only [mul_zero,zero_add] at hp
  let e (p : ℕ) (y : R) := Tendsto (fun i : ℕ => φ^[i] (Z p)) atTop (𝓝 y) ∧ defect y=0 ∧ ‖y-Z p‖ ≤ C*(E p*2)
  have hE : ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ∃ y, e i y := (hy.and (hp.eventually (gt_mem_nhds
    (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/2)))).mono (fun i hi => rectify A C (E i) hC _ hi.1 le_rfl (le_of_lt hi.2) hc)
  classical
  let P (n : ℕ) := if h : ∃ y, e n y then h.choose else z
  replace hE : ∀ᶠ i in atTop,e i (P i) := hE.mono fun i hi => by dsimp only [P]; rw [dif_pos hi];exact hi.choose_spec
  refine ⟨P,hE.mono (fun i hi => ⟨hi.1,hi.2.1⟩),?_⟩
  have hv : Tendsto (fun i => P i-Z i) atTop (𝓝 0) := tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mpr (squeeze_zero'
    (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (hE.mono fun i hi => hi.2.2) hh)
  simpa using hv.add ht
ends.conclusion: `stable` supplies the projections `P_k → P` as limits of the `φ`-iterates.

lemma enough (D : I → R) (l r : I → I) (h : Relations D l r) (he : ∀ i, ‖D i‖ < 1/2) : ∀ i, D i=0 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨y,hy,hp⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ (fun i => ‖D i‖) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have mt i := hp i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hn i j : ‖D i*D j‖ ≤ ‖D y‖^2 := (norm_mul_le _ _).trans
    (sq ‖D y‖ ▸ mul_le_mul (mt i) (mt j) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
  have hx : ‖D y‖ ≤ ‖D y‖^2 + ‖D y‖^2 := calc
                                                ‖D y‖ = _ := congr_arg norm (h y)
                                                _ ≤ _ := (norm_sub_le ..).trans (add_le_add (hn ..) (hn ..))
  intro i; refine norm_eq_zero.mp ?_
  have ht : ‖D y‖=0 := by nlinarith [he y, norm_nonneg (D y)]
  exact le_antisymm ((mt i).trans ht.le) (norm_nonneg _)

lemma realize (B : ℕ → I → Mat X) (C : I → Mat X) (l r : I → I) (hb : ∀ i, Tendsto (fun n => B n i) atTop (𝓝 (C i)))
    (hf : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, Relations (B n) l r) (hc : Relations C l r) (p : List ℝ) (hA : Works p C) (S : AddSubgroup (Mat X))
    (h : 1∈S) (hs : IsClosed (S : Set (Mat X))) (ht : ∀ᶠ i in atTop, Tracks S p C (B i)) : ∀ᶠ i in atTop,
    ∃ f : Mat X, IsUnit f ∧ f∈S ∧ ∀ j, B i j*f = f*C j := by
  let D j n := effect (B n j) (C j)
  have he j := (cont (C j)).continuousAt (x := C j) |>.tendsto.comp (hb j)
  have hv : ∀ᶠ i in atTop, Relations (flip D i) l r := hf.mono (fun i hi => relations _ _ _ _ hi hc)
  obtain ⟨Q,hQ,hy⟩ := onto _ _ D _ he hv _ _ (wave_c p (flip B) C C hb) hA.idempotent hA.kills (preserves S)
    (closed S hs) (ht.mono (fun i hi => hi.1)) (ht.mono (fun i hi => hi.2))
  let f n := Q n 1
  have hp : Tendsto f atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    rw [← hA.fixes]
    exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℂ (Mat X) (1 : Mat X)).continuous.tendsto _).comp hQ
  filter_upwards [hy, hp.eventually (Units.isOpen.mem_nhds isUnit_one)] with i hi hw
  refine ⟨f i,hw, (show MapsTo (Q i) S S from hi.1) h,fun j => sub_eq_zero.mp ?_⟩
  change effect _ _ ((Q i) 1)=0
  exact congr_arg (fun A : End X => A 1) (hi.2.2 j).2

theorem produces {A : S.RealSpin} {a : (comparator L).RealSpin} (D : SpinRows S) (h : ∀ d, ∃ U z, Tilt P A a D d U z)
    (he : Port P a) :
    ∃ V : ∀ d, change S d, (∀ d, realH A a (V d)) ∧ Port (morph P D V) A := by
  choose U z hv using h
  choose V hw hz using fun d => meet P _ (hv d)
  refine ⟨V,hw,fun_prop_rest V hw hz⟩
where

    Port (morph P D V) A := {
    spin := fun d x => (V d).toLinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional.comp (he.spin d ((V d).symm x))
    fixes := fun d x => by simp [morph,he.fixes]
    sends := fun d v x p => by simp [morph,he.sends]
    signed := fun d v x => by
      simp only [morph,LinearEquiv.trans_apply,he.signed,(hp d).1, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    real := fun d s x => by
      obtain ⟨u,rfl⟩ := (V d).surjective x
      simp only [morph,LinearEquiv.trans_apply,← (hp d).2, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply,he.real]

      let L := (V d).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.restrictScalars ℝ

      exact L.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 (he.spinAt d g u) }

private theorem cov_parameter (H : S.Hierarchy) (V : DiffPlan S) (hd : V.Derivatives S)
    (U : Rotation S) (hU : Spin.Port U H.spin)
    (hs : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : Points n), x ∈ conf n → Still V U.lie x)
    (K : Ortho.Skew) (t : ℝ) : Cov U (Ortho.oneParameter K t) := by
  intro n v x hx
  let f := fun s => S.useAt S (Points.move (Ortho.oneParameter K s) x) (U.label (Ortho.oneParameter K s) ∘ v)
  have he (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt f 0 s := by
    have hh : HasDerivAt f (angular V U.lie (U.label (Ortho.oneParameter K s) ∘ v) K
        (Points.move (Ortho.oneParameter K s) x)) s := parameterDeriv H V hd U hU K x hx v s
    rwa [hs n _ (Points.move_in _ hx) _ K] at hh
  have hc : f t = f 0 := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero
    (fun s => (he s).differentiableAt) (fun s => (he s).deriv) t 0
  change f t = _
  rw [hc]
  unfold f
  rw [parameter_zero]
  exact cov_one hU n v x hx

private theorem average_fixed (K : Ortho) :
    rotateStress X K (averageStress X J) = averageStress X J := calc
  _ = ∫ P : Ortho, rotateStress X K (rotateStress X P J) ∂μ :=
    map_average h J ((rotateStress X K).restrictScalars ℝ)
  _ = ∫ P : Ortho, rotateStress X (K*P) J ∂μ := by simp_rw [rotate_mul h]
  _ = averageStress X J :=
    (measurePreserving_mul_left μ K).integral_comp (Homeomorph.mulLeft K).measurableEmbedding
      (fun P : Ortho => rotateStress X P J)
ends.conclusion: `averageStress X J` is fixed by every `rotateStress X K`, by left invariance of Haar measure and `rotate_mul`.

theorem conserved_average (c : Conserved V H J) : Conserved V H (averageStress X J) where
  symmetric a b := by
    rw [average_component h, average_component h]
    exact integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun K =>
      (rotate_conserved h K J c).symmetric a b)
  real a b := calc
    _ = ∫ K : Ortho, S.conj H 4 (rotateStress X K J a b) ∂μ :=
      map_average h J (realConjugateComponent H a b)
    _ = ∫ K : Ortho, rotateStress X K J a b ∂μ :=
      integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun K =>
        (rotate_conserved h K J c).real a b)
    _ = _ := (average_component h J a b).symm
  divergence b := by
    calc
      _ = divergenceMap V b (averageStress X J) := (divergenceMap_apply V b _).symm
      _ = ∫ K : Ortho, divergenceMap V b (rotateStress X K J) ∂μ :=
        map_average h J ((divergenceMap V b).restrictScalars ℝ)
      _ = ∫ _ : Ortho, (0 : S.Field (4+1)) ∂μ :=
        integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun K =>
          (divergenceMap_apply V b _).trans ((rotate_conserved h K J c).divergence b))
      _ = 0 := integral_zero _ _
ends.conclusion: `averageStress X J` is symmetric, real and divergence-free, the integrals commuting with the linear maps `component`, `S.conj` and `divergenceMap` via `map_average`.

theorem rotate_conserved {V : DiffPlan S} {H : S.RealSpin} {X : Rotation S}
    (h : X.Laws V H) (K : Ortho) (J : S.Stress) (c : Conserved V H J) :

    rw [rotateStress_apply, rotateStress_apply, Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [mul_comm (K.val a i), c.symmetric i j]

theorem stressLaws_average (A : Bid.A10) (hc : S.Hierarchy) (u : X.Laws V hc.spin)
    (xO : X.Oriented S) (c : StressLaws S J V.deriv X.lie) :
    StressLaws S (averageStress X J) V.deriv X.lie where
  translation := by
    intro n x hx q χ w b d B
    calc
      _ = translationFlux hx w hc.smooth q B b (averageStress X J) :=
        (translationFlux_apply hx w hc.smooth q B b _).symm
      _ = ∫ K : Ortho, translationFlux hx w hc.smooth q B b (rotateStress X K J) ∂μ :=
        map_average u J ((translationFlux hx w hc.smooth q B b).restrictScalars ℝ)
      _ = ∫ _ : Ortho, S.useAt S x (Fin.cons ⟨d+1,V.deriv d b B⟩ q) ∂μ :=
        integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun K =>
          (translationFlux_apply hx w hc.smooth q B b _).trans
            ((rotate_flux A hc u xO K J c).translation hx q w b d B))
      _ = _ := by simp
  rotation := by
    intro n x hx q χ w g d B
    calc
      _ = angularFlux hx w hc.smooth q B g (averageStress X J) :=
        (angularFlux_apply hx w hc.smooth q B g _).symm
      _ = ∫ K : Ortho, angularFlux hx w hc.smooth q B g (rotateStress X K J) ∂μ :=
        map_average u J ((angularFlux hx w hc.smooth q B g).restrictScalars ℝ)
      _ = ∫ _ : Ortho, S.useAt S x (Fin.cons ⟨d,X.lie d g B⟩ q) ∂μ :=
        integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun K =>
          (angularFlux_apply hx w hc.smooth q B g _).trans
            ((rotate_flux A hc u xO K J c).rotation hx q w g d B))
      _ = _ := by simp
ends.conclusion: `averageStress X J` has both shell laws `StressLaws`, obtained by pulling the integral through `translationFlux` and `angularFlux` and using the laws of each `rotateStress X K J`.

theorem rotate_flux (A : Bid.A10) {V : DiffPlan S} (H : S.Hierarchy) {X : Rotation S}
    (h : X.Laws V H.spin) (p : X.Oriented S) (K : Ortho) (J : S.Stress)
    (c : StressLaws S J V.deriv X.lie) : StressLaws S (rotateStress X K J) V.deriv X.lie where
  translation := by
    intro n x hx q χ w b d B
    let x' := Points.move K⁻¹ x
    let q' := X.label K⁻¹ ∘ q
    let B' := X.act d K⁻¹ B
    have hx' : x' ∈ conf (n+1) := Points.move_in K⁻¹ hx
    have w' := window_pull K w
    calc
      _ = fluxCore x (Fin.cons ⟨d,B⟩ q) χ (fun _ => basis b) (rotateStress X K J) :=
        (fluxCore_basis hx w H.smooth q B (rotateStress X K J) b).symm
      _ = fluxCore x' (Fin.cons ⟨d,B'⟩ q') (χ ∘ Ortho.move K)
          (fun _ => Ortho.move K⁻¹ (basis b)) J := by
        rw [pull_flux h p K hx w, label_cons]
      _ = ∑ j : Axis, ((Ortho.move K⁻¹ (basis b) j : ℝ) : ℂ) •
          S.useAt S x' (Fin.cons ⟨d+1,V.deriv d j B'⟩ q') := by
        rw [fluxCore_const hx' w' H.smooth]
        simp_rw [c.translation hx' q' w']
      _ = front x' q' (d+1) (X.act (d+1) K⁻¹ (V.deriv d b B)) := by
        rw [h.vector]
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul, front_apply, B', Ortho.move, M4.move_basis]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [front_apply]; exact oriented_cons p K⁻¹ hx q (d+1) (V.deriv d b B)
  rotation := by
    intro n x hx q χ w g d B
    let x' := Points.move K⁻¹ x
    let q' := X.label K⁻¹ ∘ q
    let B' := X.act d K⁻¹ B
    have hx' : x' ∈ conf (n+1) := Points.move_in K⁻¹ hx
    have w' := window_pull K w
    let g' := pullSkew K g
    have ad : X.act d K⁻¹ (X.lie d g B) = X.lie d g' B' :=
      (A H.spin X ⟨h.spin,h.fixes,h.group,h.signed,h.real,h.infinitesimal⟩).2 d K⁻¹ g B
    calc
      _ = fluxCore x (Fin.cons ⟨d,B⟩ q) χ (fun y => M4.move g.val (y-x 0)) (rotateStress X K J) :=
        (fluxCore_angular hx w H.smooth q B (rotateStress X K J) g).symm
      _ = fluxCore x' (Fin.cons ⟨d,B'⟩ q') (χ ∘ Ortho.move K)
          (fun y => M4.move g'.val (y-x' 0)) J := by
        rw [pull_flux h p K hx w, label_cons]
        simp_rw [pull_centered]; rfl
      _ = S.useAt S x' (Fin.cons ⟨d,X.lie d g' B'⟩ q') := by
        rw [fluxCore_angular hx' w' H.smooth, c.rotation hx' q' w']
      _ = _ := by rw [← ad]; exact oriented_cons p K⁻¹ hx q d (X.lie d g B)
ends.conclusion: Each `rotateStress X K J` keeps both shell laws, by the change of variables `pull_flux` and covariance (`X.Laws`, `X.Oriented`).

theorem pull_flux {V : DiffPlan S} {H : S.RealSpin} {X : Rotation S}
    (h : X.Laws V H) (p : X.Oriented S) (K : Ortho) {x : Points (n+1)} (hx : x ∈ conf _)
    {χ : E4 → ℝ} (w : Window x χ) (q : Fin (n+1) → S.Tag) (W : E4 → E4) (J : S.Stress) :
    fluxCore x q χ W (rotateStress X K J) = fluxCore (Points.move K⁻¹ x) (X.label K⁻¹ ∘ q)
      (χ ∘ Ortho.move K) (fun y => Ortho.move K⁻¹ (W (Ortho.move K y))) J := by
  let x' := Points.move K⁻¹ x
  have hf (z : S.Tag) : X.label K (X.label K⁻¹ z) = z := by
    rcases z with ⟨d,v⟩
    change Sigma.mk d (X.act d K (X.act d K⁻¹ v)) = _
    rw [← h.group, mul_inv_cancel, h.fixes]
  let f := Ortho.motion K
  unfold fluxCore
  apply congrArg Neg.neg
  rw [← MeasurePreserving.integral_comp f.measurePreserving f.toHomeomorph.measurableEmbedding]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [(Set.finite_range x'.ofLp).countable.ae_notMem (volume : Measure E4)] with y hy
  have hxy : Points.cons y x' ∈ conf _ :=
    Fin.cons_injective_of_injective hy (show Injective x'.ofLp from Points.move_in K⁻¹ hx)
  have he : Points.move K (Points.cons y x') = Points.cons (f y) x := by
    ext1 i
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp [Points.cons, f]
    · simp [Points.cons, x']
  change front (Points.cons (f y) x) q 4
    (contractStress (gradVec χ (Ortho.move K y)) (W (Ortho.move K y)) (rotateStress X K J)) = _
  rw [contract_rotate, front_apply, front_apply, gradVec_pull K w.1]
  have orient := oriented_cons p K hxy (X.label K⁻¹ ∘ q) 4
    (contractStress (Ortho.move K⁻¹ (gradVec χ (Ortho.move K y)))
      (Ortho.move K⁻¹ (W (Ortho.move K y))) J)
  rw [show X.label K ∘ X.label K⁻¹ ∘ q = q from funext fun i => hf _, he] at orient
  exact orient
ends.conclusion: The flux of `rotateStress X K J` in window `χ` equals the flux of `J` in the window `χ ∘ move K` at the moved configuration.

lemma contract (H : S.Hierarchy) (t) (p : Voice L a) : ‖timed X t p‖ ≤ ‖X.stems p‖ := by
  let d i := ‖timed X i p‖
  have ht : BddAbove (Set.range d) := by
    obtain ⟨A,hA⟩ := enough X H p; exact ⟨A,by rintro _ ⟨y,rfl⟩; exact hA y⟩
  let c := ⨆ i : ℝ≥0, d i
  have he i : d i ≤ c := le_ciSup ht _
  have hp : 0 ≤ d t := norm_nonneg _
  have hh (i) : d i ^ 2 ≤ ‖X.stems p‖ * c := by
    change ‖timed X i p‖^2 ≤ _
    rw [sq_key X, symmetrical X H.translations]
    exact (norm_inner_le_norm ..).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (he _) (norm_nonneg _))
  let A := ‖X.stems p‖*c
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := le_trans (sq_nonneg _) (hh t)
  have h₀ := hp.trans (he t)
  have hw : c ≤ √A := ciSup_le fun i => (Real.le_sqrt (norm_nonneg (timed X i p)) hA).mpr (hh i)
  apply (he t).trans
  have hq := sq_le_sq₀ h₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg A) |>.2 hw
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt hA] at hq
  dsimp only [A] at hq
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (X.stems p)]
ends.conclusion: `‖timed X t p‖ ≤ ‖X.stems p‖`: the time translates contract.

lemma implement (H : S.Hierarchy) : ∃ C : Chamber S a, C.GNS = X := by
  choose E hE hP using fun (t : ℝ≥0) => X.by_bound (fun v => X.plant (travel v t)) 1 zero_le_one (by
    intro g; rw [one_mul]; exact contract X H t g)
  choose U hU hW using fun (x : Cross a) => X.by_bound (fun v => X.plant (over v x)) 1 zero_le_one (by
    intro g; rw [one_mul]; exact (safe X x H g).le)
  have es t : (E t).adjoint=E t := by
    apply X.by_bud; intro v
    refine X.whole.eq_of_inner_left ℂ fun f => ?_
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left]
    -- linearity on all sums; compare singles
    induction f using Finsupp.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add f g hf hg => -- extract v form after adj rewrite
      simp only [map_add, inner_add_right,hf,hg]
    | single i c =>
      simp only [Kernel.Gram.stems,Finsupp.linearCombination_single,map_smul,
        inner_smul_right,hP,X.measure,sym_time H.translations]
  have hu : U 0=ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ X.H := X.by_bud fun i => by rw [hW,pause]; rfl
  have hv (x y) : U (x+y)=(U x).comp (U y) := by
    apply X.by_bud; intro i; simp [hW, parallel, add_comm x y]
  let B : Semigroup X.H a := {
    E := E
    U := U
    eZero := X.by_bud fun i => by rw [hP,done]; rfl
    sym := es
    uZero := hu
    space := hv
    shrinks := hE
    time := fun x y => X.by_bud fun i => by simp [hP,add_comm x y]
    independent := fun t y => X.by_bud fun i => by simp [hP,hW]
    unitary := by
      intro t p
      have ht (t : Cross a) (p) : ‖U t p‖ ≤ ‖p‖ := ((U t).le_opNorm p).trans
        (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (hU _))
      refine le_antisymm (ht _ _) ?_
      have he := ht (-t) (U t p)
      rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,← hv,neg_add_cancel,hu] at he
      exact he
    continuousE := strong X (D := X.H) hE fun i => by simp_rw [hP]; exact contE X H i
    continuousU := strong X (D := X.H) hU fun i => by simp_rw [hW]; exact contU X H i
  }
  exact ⟨⟨X,B,fun t v => (hP t v).symm,fun x v => (hW x v).symm⟩,rfl⟩

lemma against (A B : V→ₗ[ℂ] V) (X : V →ₗ[ℂ] H) (D : ℝ) (h : 0<D)
    (hp : ∀ v w, inner ℂ (X (A v)) (X w)=inner ℂ (X v) (X (B w)))
    (ht : ∀ v:V, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n:ℕ, ‖X (((B ∘ₗ A)^n) v)‖ ≤ C*D^(2*n)) (v : V) :
    ‖X (A v)‖ ≤ D*‖X v‖ := by
  let T : V→ₗ[ℂ] V := B ∘ₗ A
  have hh (v w) : inner ℂ (X v) (X (T w))=inner ℂ (X (T v)) (X w) := by
    change inner ℂ (X _) (X (B _))=_
    rw [← hp,← inner_conj_symm (X (A v)),hp,inner_conj_symm];rfl
  have hw n (v w) : inner ℂ (X v) (X ((T^n) w))=inner ℂ (X ((T^n) v)) (X w) := by
    induction n generalizing v w with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      conv_rhs => rw [pow_succ]
      conv_lhs => rw [pow_succ']
      rw [show (T*T^n) w=T ((T^n) w) from rfl, hh, ih];rfl
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := ht v
  let d n := ‖X ((T^n) v)‖/D^(2*n)
  have Ht n : 0 ≤ d n := by unfold d; positivity
  have he : BddAbove (range d) := by
    refine ⟨C, fun c he => ?_⟩; obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := he
    exact (div_le_iff₀ (pow_pos h _)).2 (hC _)
  let s := ⨆ i, d i
  have hr n : d n≤s := le_ciSup he _
  have hz n : d n ^ 2 ≤ ‖X v‖ * s := by
    have hi : ‖inner ℂ (X v) (X ((T^(n+n)) v))‖= ‖X ((T^n) v)‖^2 := by
      rw [pow_add,Module.End.mul_apply, hw,inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K]; simp
    calc _ = ‖inner ℂ (X v) (X ((T^(n+n)) v))‖/D^(2*(n+n)) := by unfold d; rw [hi,div_pow, Nat.mul_add, pow_add, pow_two (D^_)]
         _ ≤ ‖X v‖*d (n+n) := by
             apply (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (norm_inner_le_norm _ _) (pow_nonneg h.le _)).trans (le_of_eq ?_); unfold d; ring
         _ ≤ _ := by gcongr; exact hr _
  have hs := (Ht 0).trans (hr 0)
  have hu : s ≤ ‖X v‖ := by
    have hx : s ≤ √(‖X v‖*s) := ciSup_le fun i => (Real.le_sqrt (Ht i) (by positivity)).mpr (hz i)
    have he := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ ‖X v‖*s by positivity)
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (X v)]
  have hy : ‖X (A v)‖^2=‖inner ℂ (X v) (X ((T^1) v))‖ := by rw [pow_one,show X (T v)=X (B (A v)) from rfl,← hp];simp
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).1
  rw [hy]
  have hr : ‖X ((T^1) v)‖ ≤ ‖X v‖*D^(2*1) := (div_le_iff₀ (pow_pos h _)).1 ((hr 1).trans hu)
  apply (norm_inner_le_norm _ _).trans
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr (norm_nonneg _)).trans_eq (by ring)

    (p : Caps n) (v : C.book.Vector p) (hp : ∀ i, star (v i)=v i) :

private lemma pair_orbit (k : Ortho) (p x : Row.Core C.book) :
    stage A [p,x] = stage A [orbit H T o k p, orbit H T o k x] := by
  let t := timeAxis
  let b := basis t
  have hb : 0 < b t := by simp [b]
  -- Need a common increasing time direction for same_up. Include equator;
  -- when time coefficient is negative first compose with theta.
  rcases lt_trichotomy 0 (Ortho.move k b t) with h|e|h
  · exact same_up A st H T o k b hb h [p,x]
  · let u := Ortho.move k⁻¹ b
    have hu : u t = 0 := by
      have h₁ := (Ortho.motion k).inner_map_map u b
      change inner ℝ (Ortho.move k (Ortho.move k⁻¹ b)) (Ortho.move k b) = inner ℝ u b at h₁
      rw [Ortho.move_inv, ← real_inner_comm u b] at h₁
      change inner ℝ (basis t) _ = inner ℝ (basis t) _ at h₁
      rw [basis_inner, basis_inner] at h₁
      exact h₁.symm.trans e.symm
    have he : 0 < (b+u) t := by simp [hu, hb]
    have hv : 0 < Ortho.move k (b+u) t := by
      rw [(show Ortho.move k (b+u) = Ortho.move k b + Ortho.move k u from
        (Ortho.motion k).map_add ..)]
      simp [u, e.symm, hb]
    exact same_up A st H T o k (b+u) he hv [p,x]
  have hv : 0 < Ortho.move (theta*k) b t := by
    simp only [Ortho.move_mul, theta, Signed.mirrored, show timeAxis = t from rfl, if_true]
    exact neg_pos.mpr h
  have hf (x : Row.Core C.book) : m A (orbit H T o (theta*k) x) = m A (orbit H T o k x) := by
    rw [← orbit_comp T H o law]
    exact (theta_individual A T H o law B hr _).symm
  calc
    _ = stage A [orbit H T o (theta*k) p, orbit H T o (theta*k) x] :=
      same_up A st H T o (theta*k) b hb hv [p,x]
    _ = _ := pair_congr A (hf p) (hf x)
ends.conclusion: Two-factor vacuum entries `stage A [p,x]` are invariant under a simultaneous rotation `k`, along a ray with positive time before and after (`same_up`), composing with `theta` when the time coefficient is negative.

private lemma second_conjugate (j : Ortho) (p x : Row.Core C.book) :
    stage A [p,x] = stage A [p, orbit H T o (j*theta*j⁻¹) x] := by
  let a := orbit H T o j⁻¹ p
  let b := orbit H T o j⁻¹ x
  let c := orbit H T o theta b
  have ha : orbit H T o j a = orbit H T o 1 p := by
    dsimp only [a]; rw [orbit_comp T H o law, mul_inv_cancel]
  have hc : orbit H T o j c = orbit H T o (j*theta*j⁻¹) x := by
    dsimp only [c, b]
    rw [orbit_comp T H o law, orbit_comp T H o law]
  calc
    _ = stage A [a,b] := pair_orbit A T H o law B st hr j⁻¹ p x
    _ = stage A [a,c] := pair_congr A rfl (theta_individual A T H o law B hr b)
    _ = stage A [orbit H T o j a, orbit H T o j c] :=
      pair_orbit A T H o law B st hr j a c
    _ = _ := pair_congr A ((congr_arg (m A) ha).trans
      (one_individual A T H o law B hr p).symm) (congr_arg (m A) hc)

private lemma theta_generates (W : Ortho → Prop) (hi : W 1)
    (hm : ∀ j k, W j → W k → W (j*k)) (hc : ∀ j : Ortho, W (j * theta * j⁻¹)) (k : Ortho) : W k := by
  have single (v : E4) : ∃ J : Ortho, W J ∧ ∀ x, Ortho.move J x = hyper v x := by
    rcases eq_or_ne v 0 with e|e
    · subst v
      exact ⟨1, hi, fun x => by rw [Ortho.move_one, hyper, reflection_orthogonal_apply,
        reflection_singleton_apply]; simp⟩
    obtain ⟨J,hJ⟩ := conj_hyper v e
    exact ⟨_, hc J, hJ⟩
  have chain (l : List E4) : ∃ J : Ortho, W J ∧ ∀ x, Ortho.move J x = (l.map hyper).prod x := by
    induction l with
    | nil => exact ⟨1,hi,fun x => (Ortho.move_one x)⟩
    | cons v l ih =>
      obtain ⟨A,hA,ha⟩ := single v
      obtain ⟨B,hB,hb⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨A*B, hm A B hA hB, fun x => by rw [Ortho.move_mul, hb, ha]; rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨l, -, hl⟩ := (Ortho.motion k).reflections_generate_dim
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, hf⟩ := chain l
  have e : k = J := Ortho.ext _ _ (fun x => by rw [hf]; exact congr_arg (fun f : E4 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E4 => f x) hl)
  exact e.symm ▸ hJ

    ((LinearMap.pi (probe' (D := D) Y k)).comp ((D.project d).comp (U k)))
  let F : (standard C).Field d →L[ℂ] (Fin X.amount→ℂ) := LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (LinearMap.pi (plot (X := X)))
  have hg k i j : f k (X.basis i) j=probe' Y k j (D.project d (Y.later k i)) := by simp [f,U]
  have hh i : Tendsto (fun n => f n (X.basis i)) atTop (𝓝 (F (X.basis i))) := by
    refine tendsto_pi_nhds.mpr fun j => ?_
    simp_rw [hg, show F (X.basis i) j=_ from plott j (X.basis i)]
    exact result Y Q P a H hi h hD j i
  have hx : Injective F := fun q p h => X.full (show _ from by
    change (fun i => (X.row i).tests _ _ q)=fun i => (X.row i).tests _ _ p; simp_rw [← plott]; exact h)
  obtain ⟨k,hk,Hk⟩ := (((converge X.basis _ _ hh).eventually (ContinuousLinearMap.isOpen_injective
      |>.mem_nhds hx)).and Q.span).exists
  change Injective (f k) at hk
  suffices hv : Surjective (S.project d ∘ₗ U k) by
    refine le_antisymm (fun i H' => ?_) (hp d)
    obtain ⟨w,hw⟩ := hv (S.project _ i)
    have ht : U k w - i ∈ D.null d := hp _ ((Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).1 (show S.project d _=0 from
      by rw [map_sub]; exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hw))
    have he := (D.null d).add_mem ht H'
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at he
    apply (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp
    change S.project d _=_
    rw [← hw]; suffices w=0 by rw [this,map_zero]
    apply hk; rw [map_zero]
    change (LinearMap.pi (probe' Y k)) (D.project d (U k w))=0
    rw [show D.project d (U k w)=0 from (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr he,map_zero]

lemma exp_real (b : Future L timeAxis) (p : R.Out) (h : Steady V) (hv : ∀ i, R.receives (T i) i) (hp : ∀ i,(T i).Hierarchy) :
    ∀ᵐ i ∂R.μ, amplitude (D i) b = (T i).expect b.val • (D i).omega0 := by
  haveI := p.normalized
  let w (i : R.X) := ‖amplitude (D i) b‖^2
  have hw i : 0≤w i := sq_nonneg _
  let F s (i : R.X) := (current (T i) b s).re
  have hu k : Continuous (F k) := Complex.continuous_re.comp (champ P H k b hv p).1
  have ht i : Tendsto (fun j => F j i) atTop (𝓝 (w i)) := Complex.continuous_re.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (trail (D i) b)
  have he s : ∀ᵐ i ∂R.μ, ‖F s i‖ ≤ F 0 i := by
    apply Eventually.of_forall; intro i
    unfold F; rw [magnitude (D i),magnitude (D i),Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_re, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (((D i).flow.norm_decrease ((D i).GNS.plant b)) (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le s : ((0:ℕ):ℝ≥0)≤ (s:ℝ≥0))) 2
  have Hz := (hu 0).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (μ := R.μ) (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  have hm := tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (μ := R.μ) (F 0) (fun n => (hu n).aestronglyMeasurable) Hz he
    (f:= w) (Eventually.of_forall ht)
  have hf k : (∫ i, F k i ∂R.μ) = (current S b k).re := by
    rw [← (champ P H k b hv p).2]; exact (integral_re ((champ P H k b hv p).1.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (μ:=R.μ) (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)))
  have hi : (∫ i, w i ∂R.μ)=‖amplitude V b‖^2 := by
    simp_rw [hf] at hm; exact tendsto_nhds_unique hm (Complex.continuous_re.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (trail V b))
  let k:= M P b.val b.property.1
  have HH i : (T i).expect b.val=R.character i k := track P _ b.property.1 i (hv i)
  let f (i : R.X) := w i- ‖R.character i k‖^2
  have H1 : Integrable w R.μ := ⟨aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae _ (fun i : ℕ => (hu i).aestronglyMeasurable (μ:=R.μ))
    (Eventually.of_forall ht),hasFiniteIntegral_of_dominated_convergence Hz.2 he (Eventually.of_forall ht)⟩
  have H2 : Integrable (fun x => ‖R.character x k‖^2) R.μ := by simpa only [Pi.pow_def] using!  ((p.weak k).norm.pow 2).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (μ := R.μ) (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  have Hz i : f i= ‖amplitude (D i) b-(T i).expect b.val • (D i).omega0‖^2 := by rw [fits (D i) (hp i).laws,HH]
  have hx : (∫ i,f i∂R.μ)=0 := by
    unfold f; rw [integral_sub H1 H2,at_M P k p, show k.val V.omega0=amplitude V b from almost P h b, hi,sub_self]
  have hh : ∀ᵐ i ∂R.μ, f i=0 := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (f:= f) (fun i => (Hz i).symm ▸ sq_nonneg _) (H1.sub H2)).1 hx
  filter_upwards [hh] with i hi; rw [Hz] at hi; exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp (by simpa only [sq_eq_zero_iff] using hi))

private lemma x_train (H : S.Hierarchy) (h : Slab timeAxis d w) (D : ℝ) (hb : ‖A.place d w‖ ≤ D)
    (v : Future C.book timeAxis) (n : ℕ) : ‖Ground.X A (ride h v n)‖ ≤ ‖Ground.X A v‖ * D^(2*n) := by
  have hd : 0 ≤ D := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) hb
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [show ride h v 0=v from rfl]; simp
  | succ n ih =>
    let u := A.place d w
    let q := Ground.X A (ride h v n)
    have he : ride h v (n+1) = entering (mirrorsSlab h) (entering h (ride h v n)) := by
      simp [ride,iterate_succ_apply']
    rw [he,x_enter A (mirrorsSlab h), x_enter A h, ← A.adjoints h H.translations]
    change ‖(u.adjoint.comp u).comp q‖ ≤ _
    change ‖q‖ ≤ _ at ih
    change ‖u‖ ≤ D at hb
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖u.adjoint.comp u‖ * ‖q‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le _ _
      _ = (‖u‖ * ‖u‖) * ‖q‖ := by rw [ContinuousLinearMap.norm_adjoint_comp_self]
      _ ≤ (D*D)*(‖Ground.X A v‖ * D^(2*n)) := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by rw [Nat.mul_add, pow_add]; ring
ends.conclusion: `ride h v n` is the power (A^* A)^n v and `X A (ride)` is the corresponding power applied to `X A v`.

  have he : ((m.factorial:ℝ))⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos m)

lemma pulse_lower {t : ℝ} (hx : t∈Icc (0:ℝ) 1) : t/Real.pi ≤ pulse t := by
  have ht := hx.2
  have hp := hx.1
  calc
    _ = ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, (2/Real.pi*t)*x := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_id]; ring
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1)
        ((show Continuous (fun x : ℝ => (2/Real.pi*t)*x) from by fun_prop).intervalIntegrable ..)
        ((show Continuous (fun u => Real.sin (t*u)) from by fun_prop).intervalIntegrable ..)
      intro x h
      have he := h.1
      have hh : t*x ≤ Real.pi/2 := (mul_le_one₀ ht he h.2).trans (by linarith [Real.two_le_pi])
      rw [mul_assoc]; exact Real.mul_le_sin (mul_nonneg hp he) hh
ends.conclusion: `pulse t = ∫_0^1 sin (t x) dx = (1-cos t)/t` satisfies `t/π ≤ pulse t` on `[0,1]`.

theorem dyadic (μ : Measure E4) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (M : ℝ) (hM : 0≤ M)
    (h : ∀ u ∈ Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, μ.real (ringE u) ≤ M*u^2) (u : ℝ) (hu : u ∈ Ioc (0:ℝ) 1) :
    μ.real (lowE u) ≤ (2*M)*u^2 := by
  have he := hu.1
  let w (n : ℕ) := u*(2⁻¹ : ℝ)^n
  have hw n : w n ∈ Ioc 0 1 := ⟨by unfold w; positivity, mul_le_one₀ hu.2 (by positivity)
    (pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num))⟩
  have hv n : μ (ringE (w n)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (M*u^2) * (2⁻¹ : ℝ≥0∞)^n := by
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (measure_ne_top μ _)]
    have hh := h (w n) (hw n)
    calc
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (M*(w n)^2) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hh
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (M*u^2*(2⁻¹ : ℝ)^n) := by
        refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_
        rw [mul_assoc]; unfold w; rw [mul_pow]
        gcongr; rw [pow_two]; apply mul_le_of_le_one_left (by positivity) (pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num))
      _ = _ := by rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity),ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by positivity), ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos (by positivity), ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat]
  have hp : lowE u ⊆ ⋃ n, ringE (w n) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨i,hp,hq⟩ := exists_nat_pow_near_of_lt_one (div_pos hx.1 he) ((div_le_one he).2 hx.2)
      (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)< 2⁻¹) (by norm_num)
    refine mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, ?_⟩
    change w i / 2 < _ ∧ _ ≤ w i
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ he] at hp; rw [div_le_iff₀ he] at hq
    unfold w
    constructor
    · refine lt_of_eq_of_lt ?_ hp; rw [pow_succ]; ring
    simpa [mul_comm] using hq
  have hm := calc μ (lowE u) ≤ ∑' n, μ (ringE (w n)) := (measure_mono hp).trans (measure_iUnion_le _)
                  _ ≤ _ := ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hv
  rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_left,ENNReal.tsum_geometric_two, show ENNReal.ofReal (M*u^2)* (2:ℝ≥0∞)=ENNReal.ofReal (2*M*u^2) from by
    conv_rhs => rw [show 2*M*u^2=M*u^2*2 by ring, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity), ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat] ] at hm

theorem decay (μ : Measure E4) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (C : ℝ) (_ : 0≤C)
    (h : ∀ u > (0:ℝ), μ.real (lowE u) ≤ C*u^2) (s : ℝ≥0) (hs : 0<s) :
    (∫ p in aboveE, boltz s p ∂μ) ≤ (C*Real.Gamma 3)*(s:ℝ)⁻¹^2 := by
  classical
  let r : ℝ := s
  have hr : 0 < r := hs
  let f (t : ℝ) := r * Real.exp (-r*t)
  let g (p : E4) := (Ici (time p)).indicator f
  let V := μ.restrict aboveE
  let T := volume.restrict (Ioi (0:ℝ))
  have hf : Integrable f T := (integrableOn_exp_mul_Ioi (neg_lt_zero.mpr hr) 0).const_mul _
  have hg : Integrable (uncurry g) (V.prod T) := by
    let S := {x : E4 × ℝ | time x.1 ≤ x.2}
    have hv : MeasurableSet S := (isClosed_le (clock_cont.comp continuous_fst) continuous_snd).measurableSet
    have he : uncurry g=S.indicator (f ∘ Prod.snd) := by
      funext x; by_cases h : x ∈ S
      · exact (indicator_of_mem h (f:=f ∘ Prod.snd)).symm ▸ (indicator_of_mem h (s:=Ici (time x.1)) (f:=f))
      rw [indicator_of_notMem h]; exact indicator_of_notMem (s:=Ici (time x.1)) (a:=x.2) h f
    haveI : IsFiniteMeasure V := by unfold V; infer_instance
    rw [he]; exact (hf.comp_snd (μ:=V)).indicator hv
  haveI : SigmaFinite T := by unfold T; infer_instance
  haveI : SigmaFinite V := by unfold V; infer_instance
  calc
    _ = ∫ p, (∫ t, g p t ∂T) ∂V := by
      apply setIntegral_congr_fun aboveE_m; intro p (hp : p∈aboveE)
      have hk : Ici (time p) ⊆ Ioi 0 := fun t ht => show 0 < t from lt_of_lt_of_le (show 0<time p from hp) ht
      dsimp only [T,g]; rw [integral_indicator measurableSet_Ici,Measure.restrict_restrict_of_subset hk, integral_Ici_eq_integral_Ioi]
      unfold f; rw [integral_const_mul, integral_exp_mul_Ioi (neg_lt_zero.mpr hr)]
      change Real.exp (-r*time p) = _; field_simp
    _ = ∫ t, (∫ p, g p t ∂V) ∂T := integral_integral_swap hg
    _ ≤ ∫ t, (C*r)*(t^2 * Real.exp (-r*t)) ∂T := by
      have hb : Integrable (fun t => t^2 * Real.exp (-r*t)) T := by
        by_contra! hh
        have ht := integral_undef hh; dsimp only [T] at ht; rw [density_power r hr] at ht
        exact (ne_of_gt (by positivity)) ht
      apply integral_mono_ae hg.integral_prod_right (hb.const_mul _)
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem (μ:=volume) measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
      have he : 0≤ f t := mul_nonneg hr.le (Real.exp_pos _).le
      let s' := {p | time p ≤ t}
      have hh : (g · t) = s'.indicator (fun _ => f t) := by
        ext p; by_cases h : p ∈ s'
        · rw [indicator_of_mem h]; exact indicator_of_mem (s:=Ici (time p)) (a:=t) h _
        rw [indicator_of_notMem h]; exact indicator_of_notMem (s:=Ici (time p)) (a:=t) h _
      have ht' : s' ∩ aboveE=lowE t := by ext p; exact and_comm
      change (∫ x : E4, g x t ∂V) ≤ _
      dsimp only [V]
      rw [hh,integral_indicator (measurableSet_le clock_cont.measurable measurable_const),
        Measure.restrict_restrict (measurableSet_le clock_cont.measurable measurable_const), ht', setIntegral_const,
        smul_eq_mul]
      apply (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h t ht) he).trans_eq
      unfold f; ring
    _ = _ := by
      rw [integral_const_mul]; dsimp only [T]; rw [density_power _ hr]; change _ = _ * r⁻¹^2
      field_simp

  obtain ⟨C,hC,hL⟩ := light_bound L w h

  have hI i (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) : (νletter L i w).real (lowE x) ≤ D*x^2 := by
    by_cases H : x ≤ 1

  refine ⟨D*Real.Gamma 3, by positivity, fun i s hs => ?_⟩
  have hh := zero_lt_one.trans_le hs
  dsimp only
  rw [residual_pair (L.links i) (L.cores i) s]

private theorem saturated {F G : ℂ → ℂ} {C D : ℝ} (hF : Air F C) (hG : Air G D)
    (h : ∀ x : ℝ, F (x:ℂ)=G (- (x:ℂ))) : ∀ z∈high, F z=F 0 := by
  classical
  let L : ℂ → ℂ := high.piecewise F (fun z => G (-z))
  let v := {x : ℂ| x.im ≤ 0}
  have he : EqOn L F high := piecewise_eqOn _ _ _
  have hl : EqOn L (fun z => G (-z)) v := by
    intro z hp; by_cases hZ : z.im=0
    · rw [he (show z∈high from hZ.symm.le),show z = (↑z.re:ℂ) from Complex.ext rfl (by simpa)]
      exact h z.re
    unfold L; rw [piecewise_eq_of_notMem _ _ _ (show z ∉ high from fun hh => hZ (le_antisymm hp hh))]
  have hc : Continuous L := by
    have hF' := hF.connects.congr he
    have hG' : ContinuousOn L v := ((hG.connects.comp continuous_neg.continuousOn (fun z hz =>
      show 0≤(-z).im by simpa using (show z.im≤0 from hz))) : ContinuousOn (fun z => G (-z)) v).congr hl
    apply continuousOn_univ.mp
    rw [show (@univ ℂ)=high∪v from by ext z; exact ⟨fun _ => le_total 0 z.im,fun _ => trivial⟩]
    exact hF'.union_of_isClosed hG' highC (isClosed_le continuous_im continuous_const)
  have hx : DifferentiableOn ℂ L loft := hF.straight.congr (he.mono Paley.subset)
  have hu : DifferentiableOn ℂ L {z : ℂ| z.im < 0} :=
    (hG.straight.comp (f:=-id) (differentiable_id.neg.differentiableOn) (fun z hz => show 0<(-z).im by simpa using (show z.im<0 from hz))).congr
      (fun z hz => hl (show z.im≤0 from (show z.im<0 from hz).le))
  have hp := paste hc hx hu
  have hh : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range L) := (Metric.isBounded_closedBall (x:= (0:ℂ)) (r:=max C D)).subset (by
    rintro _ ⟨z,rfl⟩
    rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]; rcases le_total 0 z.im with H|H
    · exact (he H).symm ▸ le_trans (hF.bounded z H) (le_max_left C D)
    rw [hl H]; exact (hG.bounded (-z) (by simpa [high] using H)).trans (le_max_right C D))
  exact fun z hz => (he hz).symm.trans ((hp.apply_eq_apply_of_bounded hh z 0).trans (he (by simp [high])))

lemma tail_budget (A : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (f : Probe E4) (ε : ℝ) (he : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ F : E4 → ℂ, Continuous F ∧ HasCompactSupport F ∧
    ∀ μ : Measure E4, AllowsLaplace μ → energyBudget μ A k → dist (∫ x,F x ∂μ) (∫ x,f x ∂μ) < ε := by
    obtain ⟨C,hC,hf⟩ := schwartz_bound f ((k+1)+1)
    let q := (ENNReal.ofReal (A*2^k) * (1-(2:ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹)⁻¹).toReal
    have hq : 0 ≤ q := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
    let R := 1 + C*q/ε
    have hR : 0<R := add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg zero_lt_one (by positivity)
    let B : ContDiffBump (0:E4) := ⟨R,R+1,hR,lt_add_one _⟩
    let F : E4 → ℂ := fun x => (B x : ℝ) • f x
    have hc : Continuous F := B.continuous.smul f.continuous
    have hp : HasCompactSupport F := HasCompactSupport.smul_right (f':=⇑f) B.hasCompactSupport
    refine ⟨F,hc,hp,fun μ hL hw => ?_⟩
    haveI := temperate_of_energy μ hA hw
    let Y := fun x:E4 => ((1+‖x‖)^(k+1))⁻¹
    have h (x : E4) : ‖F x-f x‖ ≤ (C/R)*Y x := by
        by_cases ht : ‖x‖≤R
        · have hf : F x=f x := by
             unfold F; rw [B.one_of_mem_closedBall (Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr (by rwa [dist_zero_right])),one_smul]
          rw [hf,sub_self,norm_zero]; dsimp only [Y]; positivity
        have he : R ≤ 1+‖x‖ := by linarith
        have hB : -1 ≤ B x-1 ∧ B x-1 ≤ 1 := by have := B.nonneg (x:=x); have := B.le_one (x:=x); constructor <;> linarith
        calc
          _ = |B x-1| * ‖f x‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs,← norm_smul]; simp [F, sub_smul]
          _ ≤ ‖f x‖ := mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (abs_le.mpr hB)
          _ ≤ _ := (hf x).trans ?_
        rw [pow_succ, mul_inv_rev,← mul_assoc]
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv]; gcongr
    rw [dist_eq_norm, ← integral_sub (integrable_complex hL _ hc hp) f.integrable]
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (norm_integral_le_of_norm_le ((inverse_integrable hA (balls_energy hw)).const_mul (C/R)) (ae_of_all _ fun x => h x)) ?_
    rw [integral_const_mul]; apply lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (tail_integral μ A k hA hw) (show 0≤C/R by positivity))
    change C/R*q < _; rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div,div_lt_iff₀ hR]
    unfold R; rw [mul_add,mul_one,mul_div_cancel₀ _ he.ne']; linarith only [he]
ends.conclusion: For an energy budget of order `k` and a Schwartz `f`, a continuous compactly supported `F` approximates `∫ f` uniformly over all allowed measures, by summing dyadic tails (`schwartz_bound` of order `k+2`).

lemma saturate : False := by
    obtain ⟨Y⟩ := form_exists X hp
    choose d hd using fun i:Index m=> (finite_particles X hL hp Y ha ht i).2
    let s : Finset (Index m) := Finset.sigma (Finset.range 4) fun i => Finset.univ
    let D : ℝ≥0:=∑ i∈s,d i
    apply does_not_fit hp ha ht D; refine Eventually.of_forall fun k=> ?_
    unfold tally; rw [parts Y X hp,tsum_eq_sum (s:=s)]
    · rw [show (↑D:ℝ≥0∞)=∑ i∈s,↑(d i) from ENNReal.ofNNReal_finsetSum ..,Finset.sum_mul];
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i hi; apply le_trans (b:=sectorsMass (Y.wave i) (barrel i.1 k))

    intro i hi; rw [(finite_particles X hL hp Y ha ht i).1 (by simpa [s] using hi), sectors_zero]; rfl

lemma receives (H : Steady V) (v : ℕ → V.H) (x : V.H) (h : Tendsto v atTop (𝓝 x)) (u : ℕ → ℝ≥0) (hu : Tendsto u atTop atTop)
    (s : ℕ → Cross timeAxis) : Tendsto (fun i => V.flow.U (s i) (V.flow.E (u i) (v i))) atTop (𝓝 (V.flow.orth x)) := by
  apply Metric.tendsto_nhds.mpr; intro ε he
  have hh := (V.flow.emerges x).comp hu
  filter_upwards [Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp h (ε/2) (by positivity),Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hh (ε/2) (by positivity)] with i hi hp
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (dist_triangle _ (V.flow.U (s i) (V.flow.E (u i) x)) _)
  have hx : V.flow.U (s i) (V.flow.orth x)=V.flow.orth x := H (V.D.orthogonalProjectionOnto x) _
  suffices he : dist (V.flow.E (u i) (v i)) (V.flow.E (u i) x) ≤ dist (v i) x by
    simp_rw [dist_eq_norm] at *
    conv => enter [1,2]; rw [← hx]
    rw [← map_sub,V.flow.unitary,← map_sub (V.flow.U (s i)),V.flow.unitary]
    simp only [Function.comp_apply] at hp;linarith
  rw [dist_eq_norm, ← map_sub (V.flow.E _),dist_eq_norm]
  exact ((V.flow.E (u i)).le_opNorm _).trans (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (V.flow.shrinks _))
ends.conclusion: Applying `V.flow.E (u i)` to a convergent sequence `v i`, then a translation `V.flow.U (s i)`, converges to `V.flow.orth x`, using `emerges` between the slabs.

lemma prod_drop {J:Type} (Z:Finset J)(x y:J→L→ℂ)(a:J→ℝ)(hx:∀j∈Z, RateLE l T (x j) (a j))(hy:∀j∈Z, RateLE l T (y j) (a j)) (he:∀ j∈Z,RateLE l T (fun i=> x j i - y j i) (a j-γ)) : RateLE l T (fun i=> (∏ j∈Z, x j i)-(∏ j∈Z,y j i)) ((∑ j∈Z,a j)-γ):=by
    induction Z using Finset.induction with
    | empty=>simp; exact RateLE.zero l T _
    | @insert j t hj h=>

lemma from_word : Matchable Z M φ T A x s u ((sigma p:ℝ)*s) (fun t=> tokenWord M.basis (X t) p) := by
  have hx' := habitat_gives ha hU; have hs' := lt_of_le_of_lt hu hs
  refine ⟨fun r=>?_⟩; obtain ⟨n,hn⟩:= exists_nat_gt (((sigma p:ℝ)*s-r)/(s-u)); let E(t):= internal (X t) p (x t) M n
  refine ⟨E,(Override.sum (p:=bands Z.sector.derivatives n) (E:= fun j t=> M.basis.ope j (X t) p (x t) • insertToken D (x t) (M.basis.letter j)) (fun i hi=> ?_)).germ (Eventually.of_forall fun i=> Finset.sum_apply ..),?_⟩
  · have h: Override Z M φ T x s (i.1*s) (fun t=>insertToken D (x t) (M.basis.letter i)):= by
       unfold insertToken; refine .atom (RateLE.mono (RateLE.const (S.project i.1 (M.basis.letter i).2) hT) (by change 0 ≤ (i.1:ℝ)*s-i.1*s; linarith only))
    exact Override.mono (h.coeff (available_cost Z D p hT H M.coherent hx' hk hs' i)) le_rfl (by apply le_of_eq; ring)
  refine Against.of_words hT (fun J _ Y q hh he l=>?_)
  have hs:= he.windows hU pack_carries; have hf:= he.left hx pack_carries
  -- read the signed approximation before taking the bound; every allowed exterior
  have hZ := arrangement_cost Z D n p q hT H M.coherent hx' hk hs' hh hf hu (le_trans (le_of_lt ‹u<s›) hv) ‹u<s›
  apply RateLE.transfer (RateLE.mono hZ (by linarith only [div_lt_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr ‹u<s›) |>.mp hn, sub_pos.mpr ‹u<s›]))
  filter_upwards [(hk.mono hv|>.chorus hh (hs.mono ((le_of_lt ‹u<s›).trans hv))).inject,(Kept.sole φ T x 1|>.chorus hh (hf.mono ((le_of_lt ‹u<s›).trans hv))).inject] with i hP hC
  apply le_trans (le_of_eq (congr_arg norm (?_ : _= glance Z (l i) _))) (glance_bound Z (l i) _)
  rw [glance_terms Z D n _ p _ _ q (l i) hP hC]
  let S':=spectator Z (l i); let m:= readExpr D S'; let K:= tokenWord D (Y i) q; change m ((tokenWord D (X i) p - E i)*K)=_
  rw [sub_mul,map_sub, show m (tokenWord D (X i) p*K) = observe S' (beside (X i) (Y i)) (beside p q) by unfold m K; rw [← token_beside, read_word D M.coherent S' (spectate Z (l i)).laws.toSymmetric (spectate_respects Z _) (spectate_ready Z _),totalObserve,if_pos hP] ]
  congr 1; unfold E internal Prescription.truncated; rw [Finset.sum_mul,map_sum]; refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _=>?_
  rw [smul_mul_assoc,map_smul]; unfold Prescription.termRead K m; rw [← token_sole,← token_beside, read_word D M.coherent S' (spectate Z (l i)).laws.toSymmetric (spectate_respects Z _) (spectate_ready Z _),totalObserve,if_pos hC]; rfl

lemma row (h : Override Z M φ T x s c e)(hs : 0 ≤ s) (w : ℕ) : RateLE φ T (fun i=> M.row (x i) w (e i)) (c - w*s) := by
   induction h with
   | @atom d f h =>
     by_cases he:w ≤ d
     · simp_rw [M.row_of_field]; exact (rate_linear (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (M.splitting.part w d)) hT h).mono (by gcongr)
     simp_rw [M.row_of_field, M.splitting.beyondZero (show d<w from not_le.mp he), LinearMap.zero_apply]; exact RateLE.zero φ T (X:=S.Field w) _
   | zero => simp only [Pi.zero_apply,map_zero]; exact RateLE.zero φ T (X:=S.Field w) _
   | plus _ _ hx hy=> simp_rw [Pi.add_apply,map_add]; exact hx.add hy hT
   | germ _ h hx=> exact hx.congr (h.mono fun i hi=> congr_arg (M.row (x i) w) hi)

lemma Against.row {w : ℕ} (e : W→ Expression Z.sector.derivatives)
    (h : Against Z M φ T A s v c e) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hc : Fits M φ w x A) (hE : ∃ u, Fine M φ T A 1 u e) : RateLE φ T (fun i=> M.row (x i) w (e i)) (c+probeFee M w*v) := by
   let θ := M.tests w; let k:=c+probeFee M w*v; let y (b:Bool) (i:W) (s:Ortho):= θ.decode (fun j=> if b then star (M.survey s j b (shiftExpr (-(x i)) (e i))) else M.survey s j b (shiftExpr (-(x i)) (e i)))
   have hm (b : Bool) (σ : W→Ortho) : RateLE φ T (fun i=> M.rotation.act w (σ i) (y b i (σ i))) k := by
      apply act_any (M:=M) hT _; apply rate_linear (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (M.tests w).decode) hT (f:=fun i j=> if b then star (M.survey (σ i) j b (shiftExpr (-(x i)) (e i))) else M.survey (σ i) j b (shiftExpr (-(x i)) (e i))); intro v hv'
      let f' i (j:(M.tests w).probes):=if b then star (M.survey (σ i) j b (shiftExpr (-(x i)) (e i))) else M.survey (σ i) j b (shiftExpr (-(x i)) (e i))
      have he(j:(M.tests w).probes):RateLE φ T (fun i=>f' i j) k:= by unfold f'; cases b; exact survey_rate M hT j h hc hs hv false σ; exact fn_star (survey_rate M hT j h hc hs hv true σ)
      filter_upwards [eventually_all.mpr fun j=> he j v hv'] with i hi using (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (Real.exp_nonneg (v*T i)) (x:=f' i)).mpr hi
   have he(b : Bool):= fn_integral (f:=fun s i=> M.rotation.act w s (y b i s)) (hm b); let f:=M.hierarchy.spin
   let g(i:W):= M.base w (shiftExpr (-(x i)) (e i))
   apply rate_linear (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (M.splitting.top w)) hT (f:=g); refine RateLE.congr ((((RateLE.const ((2:ℂ)⁻¹) hT).smul ((he false).add (fn_real (M:=M) hT (he true)) hT)).mono (le_of_eq (zero_add k)))) ?_
   filter_upwards [hE.choose_spec.fit_shift hc le_rfl] with i hi using (M.base_survey w hi).symm
ends.conclusion: A row is bounded by averaging the probe surveys over `O(4)`, at the cost `probeFee` raised by the precision.

lemma Funds.drop (h : Funds Z M φ T A s c e) (hp : Fits M φ w x A) (hs : u ≤ s)(hv : s ≤ 1)(hu : 0 ≤ u) : Funds Z M φ T A u (c-(w+1:ℝ)*(s-u)) (e-statedProject M w x e) := by

  · subst u; rw [sub_self,mul_zero,sub_zero,sub_eq_add_neg]; exact h.plus hT ((h.allProjected hT H ha hx hu hv hp).funds hv).minus
  refine ⟨loose_diff h.loose ((h.allProjected hT H ha hx (hu.trans hs.le) hv hp).increase_layer hv),fun q=>?_⟩
  let v := min q (q - maxFee M w - w*u)
  obtain ⟨g,hh,hq⟩:= (Matchable.layer hT H ha hs hu hv hx h).replaces v
  refine ⟨(g-statedProject M w x g), hh.residue hT hu hs.le w hx,?_⟩
  have he : Precision Z M φ T A u q (statedProject M w x (e-g)):= by
     apply Against.mono ((precision_project hT hq hp hx hu (loose_diff h.loose ((hh.fine hT hx).increase_layer hv))).tests (Z:=Z) hT H hu (hs.le.trans hv)) le_rfl _ (by rfl)
     linarith only [show v ≤ q-maxFee M w-w*u from min_le_right ..]
  rw [show e-statedProject M w x e-(g-statedProject M w x g) = e-g-statedProject M w x (e-g) from funext fun i=>by simp only [Pi.sub_apply,statedProject,map_sub]; abel]

lemma residue (h : Override Z M φ T x s c e)(hs : 0 ≤ u)(hu : u ≤ s) (w : ℕ) (hx : x∈A) : Fine M φ T A u
      (c - (w+1:ℝ)*(s-u)) (fun i=> M.residue (x i) w (e i)):= by
   induction h with
   | @atom d f h =>
     by_cases he : d ≤ w
     · simp_rw [M.residue_low _ he]; exact .zero
     -- every output of grade ≤w paid with price of same term of grade d
     have he' : (w:ℝ)+1 ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.add_one_le_of_lt (not_le.mp he))
     have hl : c-(d:ℝ)*s ≤ c-(w+1:ℝ)*(s-u)-d*u:= by linarith only [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he' (sub_nonneg.mpr hu)]
     let g(i):= M.project (x i) w (insertField D (x i) d (f i)); have hf : RateLE φ T g (c-(d:ℝ)*s):= by
        unfold g; simp_rw [← M.project_through,M.row_of_field]; refine RateLE.sum hT fun j _=>?_
        exact rate_linear (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Z.sector.derivatives.rise (show j.val ≤ w from Nat.le_of_lt_succ j.isLt))) hT (rate_linear (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (M.splitting.part j d)) hT h)
     have hX:= Fine.field (M:=M) hT hx (hp:=h.mono hl)
     exact hX.diff (Fine.field hT hx (hf.mono (hl.trans (by gcongr; omega))))
   | zero=> simp only [Pi.zero_apply,map_zero]; exact .zero
   | plus _ _ hx hy=> simp_rw [Pi.add_apply,map_add]; exact hx.plus hy
   | germ _ h hx=> exact hx.germ (h.mono fun i hi=> congr_arg (M.residue (x i) w) hi)
ends.conclusion: For a field of degree `d <= w` the residue is zero, and for `d >= w+1` it has cost `c-(w+1)(s-u)`, including the lower fields produced by the projection.
